title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Node, PostgreSQL, AWS) - Long-Term, US Healthtech
description:
We are a US-based health insurance technology company. Our platform handles

Medicare and ACA enrollment, commission accounting, and agent management for

insurance agencies. Real money, real member data, real compliance obTHE ROLE



We are hiring our first dedicated engineer. Today the codebase is built and

maintained by the founder with AI assistance, and it has grown faster than one

person can properly review. We need someone who can read a large codebase

critically, tell us what is wrong with it, and fix it.



This is not a ticket-taking role. You will have real ownership over

architecture decisions and your opinion will shape what we build next. Over

time this can grow into leading a small team.





OUR STACK



Backend:    Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS)

Frontend:   React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind

Infra:      AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, S3, SES, Secrets Manager),

            Vercel, GitHub Actions

Auth:       Google Identity Platform, MFA enforced

AI:         AWS Bedrock, Pinecone (retrieval-augmented assistant)

Comms:      Telnyx (SMS and voice)



Scale: roughly 550 API endpoints, 75+ frontend pages, a Postgres schema with

30+ migrations, and a commission engine that reconciles carrier statements

across 17 insurance carriers.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS



- Build out our staging and deployment pipeline so changes are verified

  before they reach production

- Decompose a large monolithic Express file into maintainable route modules,

  without changing behavior

- Raise test coverage from near zero to something we can actually rely on

- Strengthen authorization checks across the API surface

- Close out the technical controls on our SOC 2 and HIPAA roadmap

  (AWS configuration, logging, access review, key management)

- Tell us honestly what we should be working on that we are not





REQUIREMENTS



- 5+ years building and maintaining production web applications

- Strong Node.js and Express. You should be comfortable in a large, messy,

  real-world codebase, not just greenfield projects

- Strong PostgreSQL. You should be able to read a slow query, explain why it

  is slow, and fix it. Tell us the largest schema you have worked with

- Hands-on AWS. You have deployed and operated services yourself, not just

  handed off to someone else

- TypeScript and React

- You write tests. Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or equivalent

- You have done code review on someone else's work and can explain what you

  look for

- Excellent written English. Much of our communication will be written

- Minimum 3 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (that is roughly

  9pm to midnight Manila time). This is a hard requirement, please do not

  apply if you cannot commit to it





NICE TO HAVE



- Healthcare, insurance, fintech, or any regulated industry experience

- SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar compliance work

- Experience breaking up a monolith incrementally

- Production experience with LLM APIs and retrieval systems

- Open source contributions





PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- Your primary experience is WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or Elementor

- You do not have a GitHub profile with real, readable code on it

- You cannot commit to the overlap hours above

- You are looking for short-term or project-based work. We want someone

  long-termligations.

We operate under HIPAA and are working toward SOC 2 Type II.



We are small, we ship constantly, and the product is already in daily

production use.



HOURS



Our team works US hours. The ideal candidate matches that: roughly 9pm to

6am Manila time, covering a full US Central business day.



If you cannot do the full shift but can commit to at least 4 hours of daily

overlap with US Central mornings, apply anyway and tell us what schedule

you can sustain. We would rather find the right engineer and work out the

hours than lose them over a schedule.

Digital Marketing & SEO Virtual Assistant
description:
**Website | Local SEO | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We operate a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term. That means we care about **results, sustainability, accountability, and systems that actually work** — not vanity metrics, buzzwords, shortcuts, or activity that looks busy but produces no real business.



We are looking for a skilled **Digital Marketing & SEO Virtual Assistant** who understands how websites, local SEO, Google Business Profiles, landing pages, call tracking, and digital marketing work together to generate **qualified inquiries and real phone calls**.



This is a **hands-on execution role**.



We are not looking for someone who only gives recommendations or creates reports. We need someone who can identify what needs improvement, make the changes, track the results, and keep improving the system over time.



## Your Main Goal



Your job is simple to understand:



**Help more qualified families find us, trust us, and contact us for home care services.**



Traffic alone does not impress us.



Rankings alone do not impress us.



Clicks alone do not impress us.



We care about whether our marketing produces **qualified calls, inquiries, consultations, and ultimately new clients.**



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



### Website Management



- Maintain and update website pages and content

- Make basic UX and conversion improvements

- Improve mobile usability

- Monitor site speed and performance

- Maintain basic technical SEO hygiene

- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Support location-specific pages for local lead generation

- Identify and fix obvious website problems that may reduce conversions



### Local SEO & On-Page SEO



- Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headers, content, and internal linking

- Perform keyword research based on actual search intent

- Focus on keywords likely to produce calls and inquiries — not traffic for traffic’s sake

- Improve visibility within our service areas

- Monitor keyword rankings and local search performance

- Identify pages that are underperforming and make improvements

- Support local citation and directory consistency where appropriate

- Help strengthen the website’s overall local authority



### Google Business Profile Management



- Optimize and maintain Google Business Profile locations

- Publish useful posts, photos, and updates

- Monitor profile accuracy

- Support review monitoring and professional responses

- Track important activity such as:

  - Phone calls

  - Website visits

  - Direction requests

  - Search visibility

- Identify opportunities to improve local map visibility



### Digital & Call-Driven Marketing



We are especially interested in candidates who understand that for a local service business, **the phone call matters.**



You may:



- Support Google Ads or other digital campaigns designed to generate qualified calls

- Help improve landing pages and conversion messaging

- Assist with call tracking setup

- Review which campaigns, keywords, and pages generate calls

- Help distinguish between good leads and poor-quality inquiries

- Recommend and implement improvements based on actual call results

- Coordinate basic follow-up workflows connected to inbound leads



### Tracking, Reporting & Accountability



You will provide clear weekly reporting on:



- Website performance

- SEO progress

- Local search visibility

- Google Business Profile activity

- Calls and inquiries generated

- Landing-page performance

- Problems discovered

- Actions completed

- Priorities for the following week



We do not need complicated reports full of numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



**What worked?  

What didn’t?  

Why?  

What are we going to change next?**



## Required Skills & Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or similar website platforms

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- Basic call tracking

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar platforms



Experience with local service businesses is strongly preferred.



Experience in home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven service business is a plus.



## You’re Likely a Strong Fit If You:



- Care more about results than buzzwords

- Can execute without constant supervision

- Think in systems rather than isolated tasks

- Can prioritize what will have the greatest business impact

- Are comfortable being measured on outcomes

- Take ownership when something is not working

- Communicate clearly and directly

- Can explain technical marketing concepts in simple language

- Pay attention to detail

- Follow through consistently

- Prefer long-term improvement over quick tricks



We also value someone who can say:



**“This isn’t working, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather hear the truth early than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## What This Position Is NOT



This is not:



- A social-media posting role

- An influencer or branding position

- A graphic-design-only job

- A strategy-only consulting position

- A role for someone who simply generates AI content and uploads it

- A place for spammy SEO, fake backlinks, fake reviews, or shortcuts

- A position where success is measured by impressions and clicks alone



## Work Details



- Remote / Virtual

- Part-time to start

- Opportunity to grow into a larger role

- Flexible working hours

- Outcome-focused

- Long-term position for the right person



For someone who performs well, this role has the potential to become an important part of our long-term marketing and growth system.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief summary of your relevant experience

2. Examples of websites you have managed

3. Examples of local SEO work you have completed

4. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed

5. A short explanation of how you would help a local home care company generate more qualified phone calls



If you have experience with call tracking, Google Ads, landing pages, or conversion optimization, please mention that as well.



Finally, if you have read this entire posting, put the word:



**GEMINI**



in the title or subject line of your application.



Applications without **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

We are a growing home care company with a clear mission:

We are building for the long term.



Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results.



We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team.



This is a **direct-hire position**.



It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time.



## Your Primary Goal



Your main responsibility is straightforward:



**Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.**



Everything else supports that goal.



Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us.



Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients.



Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results.



## What You Will Own



### Website Management & Optimization



You will help continuously improve our website by:



- Updating and improving website pages and content

- Managing WordPress or a similar CMS

- Improving site speed and mobile performance

- Improving usability and conversion flow

- Identifying and correcting technical SEO issues

- Fixing broken links, indexing problems, page structure, and other technical issues

- Identifying pages that are underperforming and improving them



### Local SEO



You will help us improve local search visibility throughout our service areas.



Responsibilities include:



- Keyword research based on **search intent**

- Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone

- On-page SEO

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- Header structure

- Internal linking

- Content optimization

- Local service-area optimization

- Monitoring rankings and making adjustments based on performance

- Supporting appropriate citations and local directory consistency



### Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization



You will:



- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Develop location-specific pages where appropriate

- Improve calls-to-action and messaging

- Analyze conversion performance

- Make changes based on actual results rather than assumptions

- Help turn website visitors into qualified inquiries



### Google Business Profile Management



You will manage and improve our Google Business Profiles, including:



- Profile optimization

- Posts and updates

- Photos

- Service and business information

- Review monitoring

- Review-response support

- Tracking calls, website clicks, and direction requests

- Monitoring local map visibility

- Identifying opportunities to improve local search performance



### Call-Driven Digital Marketing



We operate a local service business.



That means **phone calls matter.**



You will help us understand which marketing activities actually create qualified conversations.



This may include:



- Supporting Google Ads and other digital campaigns

- Improving ad landing pages

- Assisting with call-tracking systems

- Tracking where calls and inquiries originate

- Reviewing lead quality

- Identifying campaigns and keywords that generate good inquiries

- Identifying campaigns that waste money

- Improving messaging based on actual client conversations and lead quality



## Reporting & Accountability



We expect clear, useful weekly reporting.



We do not want large reports filled with numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



- How many qualified inquiries were generated?

- How many phone calls were generated?

- Where did those inquiries come from?

- What improved?

- What declined?

- What worked?

- What did not work?

- What did you change?

- What should we do next?



Your weekly reporting may include:



- Calls generated

- Inquiry volume

- Website performance

- Organic search performance

- Google Business Profile activity

- Ranking changes

- Landing-page performance

- Issues discovered

- Work completed

- Next priorities



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who:



- Focuses on **results rather than activity**

- Understands that traffic without conversion has limited value

- Executes without constant supervision

- Thinks in systems and repeatable processes

- Looks for the root cause of problems

- Takes ownership of their work

- Pays close attention to details

- Communicates clearly and honestly

- Is comfortable being measured on real outcomes

- Can explain technical issues in understandable language

- Continues improving rather than simply maintaining what already exists



We especially value someone who is comfortable saying:



**“This is not working. Here is why, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather identify a problem early and fix it than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## Required Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or a similar CMS

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar

- Call tracking or lead tracking



Experience working with a **local service business** is strongly preferred.



Experience with home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven business is a plus.



## This Role Is NOT For You If



This position is probably not a fit if:



- Your primary experience is social-media posting

- You primarily focus on followers, likes, or impressions

- You rely heavily on spammy backlinks or questionable SEO shortcuts

- You prefer discussing strategy instead of implementing it

- You need constant direction before taking action

- You are looking for a temporary project

- You are an agency or outsourcing company

- You plan to subcontract the work to someone else

- You are currently managing several employers or clients and intend to continue doing so



## Full-Time Commitment



This is a **full-time, dedicated position**.



If hired, this is expected to be your **primary full-time employment**.



We are not looking for someone who is simultaneously working multiple full-time jobs or servicing multiple clients during their scheduled working hours with us.



We want someone who can give the role their professional attention, become deeply familiar with our organization, and grow with the company over the long term.



## Role Structure



- Full-time

- Remote / Virtual

- Direct hire

- Individual applicants only

- No agencies

- No outsourcing teams

- Long-term opportunity

- Consistent working schedule

- Performance-focused

- Opportunity for increased responsibility based on results



## Application Process



We pay attention to how candidates follow instructions.



### Step 1 — Initial Application



Please provide:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience



2. At least **two examples** of websites you have worked on



3. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed



4. Examples of SEO work that produced actual calls, leads, or inquiries



5. In **five sentences or less**, answer:



**How would you increase qualified phone calls for a local home care company?**



6. List the marketing, SEO, analytics, and call-tracking tools you regularly use



7. Confirm the following:



**“I am applying as an individual, not as an agency or outsourcing company.”**



8. Also confirm:



**“If hired, this will be my primary full-time position, and I will not work another full-time job or service other clients during my scheduled working hours.”**



### Step 2 — Paid Skills Assessment



Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short **paid practical assessment**.



This is a real-world task designed to evaluate how you think and execute.



You may be asked to:



- Review a service page

- Identify SEO problems

- Identify conversion problems

- Recommend practical improvements

- Rewrite a section of website content

- Provide a short action plan



We use this assessment to evaluate:



- How you analyze problems

- How clearly you communicate

- Whether you prioritize correctly

- Whether you can execute

- Whether you focus on outcomes rather than theory



**We do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.**



## Final Note



We are building a stable, long-term marketing system.



We are not interested in hacks, shortcuts, inflated numbers, or activity for the sake of activity.



We want someone who can become a trusted part of our team, take responsibility for an important business function, and continuously improve results.



If you take ownership, execute consistently, communicate honestly, and focus on generating qualified inquiries, **this role can grow significantly over time.**



### One Final Instruction



If you have read this entire job posting, include the word:



**GEMINI**



in the subject line or title of your application.



Applications that do not include **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

We are a small Canadian web design company looking for a full-time Website Research & Review Assistant in the Philippines



This is an entry-level position. You do not need advanced technical skills, coding experience, or previous web-design experience. We will train the right person.



What matters most to us is:



excellent written and spoken English

good judgment

attention to detail

reliability

comfort using Google and websites

ability to follow a simple process consistently

What you will do



Your main job is to research Canadian local businesses and identify companies whose current websites are outdated, poorly designed, incomplete, or clearly in need of improvement.



For each qualified business, you will collect basic information such as:



Business name

City

Website

 address

Contact-form URL


Instagram

LinkedIn



You are not expected to write long reports or technical website audits.



We want people who can look at a business website and make a sensible judgment:



Is this a real, active business with a website that could clearly be improved?



Once trained, the normal production target will be approximately 80 accepted prospects per working day.



The important word is accepted. Sending us 80 poor-quality or unsuitable businesses does not meet the target. Accuracy and judgment matter.



What we provide

Clear training and examples

A simple repeatable workflow

Full-time remote work

Flexible Philippine daytime working hours

Opportunity to grow with a small Canadian company

Optional additional earning opportunity



Sales are not required for this job.



However, once your normal assigned work is complete and meeting our quality standard, you may also find your own clients for 3Lions if you enjoy sales or business development.



For new business that you personally originate and close outside our existing prospect pipeline, we offer a 50% share of collected project revenue.



This is optional upside — not a replacement for your regular salary.



Who this role would suit



This could be a very good first serious online job for someone who is smart, dependable and eager to learn.



Previous VA or lead-generation experience is helpful, but not required.



We would rather hire someone with excellent English, good judgment and a strong work ethic than someone with years of experience who does careless work.



You must have:



Your own reliable computer

Stable internet connection

Strong English

Basic familiarity with Google Sheets

Ability to work independently

How to apply



Start your application with the word LION so we know you read the entire posting.



Then answer these three questions:



1. Tell us a little about yourself in 4–6 sentences, in your own words.



2. Why does this type of research work interest you?



3. Find 3 Canadian local service businesses whose websites you believe could use a major redesign. For each one, send us:



business name

city

website

one short sentence explaining why you selected it



Please keep your application concise. We are not looking for a long cover letter.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a short paid practical test using the same type of work they would do in the actual job.



We are looking for someone we can train, trust and work with long term.

title: Website Quality Reviewer / Visual QA Assistant – Full Time
description:
We are a small Canadian web design company looking for a full-time Website Quality Reviewer / Visual QA Assistant in the Philippines.



Your job is to review website redesigns before they are approved for our sales team.



You do not need to be a programmer.



You do need:



excellent English

very strong attention to detail

good visual judgment

comfort using websites on desktop and mobile

the ability to notice when something looks wrong, incomplete, generic or unprofessional

the ability to explain a problem clearly in one or two sentences

What you will do



For each assignment, you will usually receive:



the business’s current website

our redesigned demo website



Your job is to compare them and d
 whether the demo is ready.



You will review things such as:



Does the redesign still clearly belong to the real business?

Are the company’s real logo, colours and identity being respected?

Did important services, information and useful content survive the redesign?

Is the homepage strong?

Are the important inner pages also strong?

Does the website look professional on desktop and mobile?

Are there strange spacing problems, weak image choices or awkward layouts?

Do navigation, buttons and links work?

Does the estimate / quote experience work properly?

Are there suspicious, unsupported or obviously incorrect business claims?

Does anything look generic, unfinished or obviously AI-generated?

Your output should be simple



Most reviews should end with one of two results:



PASS



or



FIX — followed by the specific issue that needs correction



Example:



FIX — The Exterior Painting page is much weaker than the homepage and uses the same repeated layout as the Interior page.



We do not want long reports.



We want good judgment and useful observations.



Daily target



Once fully trained, the normal target will be approximately 80 accepted website audits per working day.



The important word is accepted.



Speed matters, but accuracy matters more.



If obvious problems are missed, the audit does not count simply because it was completed quickly.



Why this role matters



Your reviews help improve both the individual website and the way we build future websites.



If you notice the same problem repeatedly across several websites, we want you to flag that pattern.



For example:



service pages repeatedly feel too generic

mobile headers repeatedly have spacing problems

important source content keeps disappearing

quote buttons are hard to find

image crops repeatedly look poor



Repeated findings help us improve our production process.



What we provide

Clear training and examples

A repeatable review process

Full-time remote work

Flexible Philippine daytime working hours

Opportunity to grow with a small Canadian company

Optional additional earning opportunity



Sales are not required for this position.



Once your assigned daily work is complete and meeting our quality standard, you may also source your own clients for 3Lions if you enjoy sales or business development.



For new business that you personally originate and close outside our existing prospect pipeline, we offer a 50% share of collected project revenue.



This is optional additional income, not a replacement for your regular salary.



Who this role would suit



This role would suit someone who:



notices visual details other people miss

enjoys looking at websites and design

can quickly distinguish between something that looks professional and something that looks mediocre

is comfortable giving clear, direct feedback

works independently

takes accuracy seriously



Previous web-design, graphic-design, website-testing or QA experience is helpful, but coding ability is not required.



You must have:



Your own reliable computer

Stable internet connection

Strong English

Basic familiarity with Google Sheets

Ability to review websites on both desktop and mobile

How to apply



Start your application with the word ROAR so we know you read the full posting.



Then answer:



1. Tell us a little about yourself in 4–6 sentences, in your own words.



2. What makes a website look professional to you?



3. When reviewing a website, what are the first 5 things you normally notice?



Keep your application concise.



Selected applicants will complete a short paid practical test using a real original website and one of our redesigned demos.



We are looking for someone we can train, trust and work with long term.

title: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant
description:
Recruiter / Hiring Assistant

Company: 850 Club Credit

Position: Recruiter / Hiring Assistant

Type: Part-Time

Pay: $7.50/hour

Hours: Up to 10 hours per week / 40 hours per month

Bonus: $50 for each successful hire who remains with the company for at least 30 days



How to Apply

Please submit:



1. Reply to job posting with the Subject Line: IM YOUR RECRUITER

2. Your resume

3. A short description of your recruiting experience

4. The types of positions you have recruited for

5. How many candidates you typically screen before recommending someone for an interview

6. A short video via google drive or loom video link recording introducing yourself

7. Your current availability



Applications that do not follow instructions, will not be considered.



About the Role

850 Club Credit is looking for an organized, proactive Recruiter / Hiring Assistant who can help us find, screen, and organize strong candidates for our growing team.



Your job is not simply to post job listings.



Your job is to help us hire faster by filtering out weak applicants and making sure only qualified candidates reach the final interview stage.



You will handle the recruiting process from job posting through candidate screening, initial interviews, trial tasks, interview scheduling, and candidate follow-up. The CEO of 850 Club Credit, Calvin, will make all final hiring decisions



Your Responsibilities



You will:



* Post job openings on approved hiring platforms

* Review and organize incoming applications

* Remove applicants who clearly do not meet the requirements

* Screen candidates for English communication, experience, availability, pay expectations, and internet reliability

* Conduct initial candidate interviews

* Record candidate interviews using approved 850 Club Credit Zoom or Google Meet accounts

* Coordinate trial/test assignments

* Collect completed trial assignments

* Create candidate shortlists

* Score candidates using our hiring scorecard

* Present the strongest candidates to Calvin

* Schedule approved candidates on Calvin's interview calendar

* Confirm interviews with candidates

* Follow up before interviews to reduce no-shows

* Communicate hiring decisions and approved offers to selected candidates

* Track whether new hires successfully complete their trial period

* Provide recruiting updates every 2–3 days during active hiring



**IMPORTANT:** All recruiting communication must use approved 850 Club Credit
 addresses, Zoom links, Google Meet links, and company systems.



Candidate Information You Must Collect

Before recommending a candidate, you should provide:



* Full name

* Location and time zone

* Position applied for

* Pay expectations

* Schedule availability

* Relevant experience summary

* Resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

* Internet speed screenshot

* Voice recording for sales applicants

* Recording of your initial interview with the candidate

* Trial/test task results when applicable

* Recruiter score from 1–5

* Final recommendation: **Interview / Maybe / Reject**



Calvin should be able to look at your candidate report and quickly understand whether someone deserves a final interview.



Initial Hiring Sprint

Our immediate goal is to complete the first recruiting sprint within approximately 10–14 days.



Expected timeline:



**Days 1–3:** Approved job postings are live.



**Days 4–5:** First group of qualified candidates is presented.



**By Day 7:** We expect approximately 5–10 qualified applicants for priority roles.



**By Day 10:** Additional qualified candidates and initial interviews should be completed.



**By Day 14:** Strong finalists should be ready for final interviews and hiring decisions.



We expect recruiting updates approximately every **2–3 days** while positions are actively being filled.



What Success Looks Like



For each assigned position, we expect you to generate a strong pool of qualified applicants rather than simply sending us everyone who applies.



For example, an active hiring campaign may require:



**Sales Enrollment Specialist:** 10–15 qualified applicants



**Customer Service / Operations:** 5–8 qualified applicants



Quality is more important than simply hitting an application number.



We want you to protect Calvin's time by eliminating poor candidates before they reach his calendar.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

You will **not**:



* Make the final hiring decision

* Negotiate compensation beyond approved ranges

* Create company strategy

* Determine company staffing strategy

* Train employees long-term

* Manage employees after they are hired

* Change job requirements or compensation without approval



Your responsibility ends primarily with helping us identify, screen, organize, and successfully hire great candidates.



Compensation



**$7.50/hour**



Maximum of approximately **10 hours per week / 40 hours per month** unless additional hours are approved in advance.



There is also a:



**$50 Successful Hire Bonus**



The bonus is earned for each approved candidate you recruit who is hired and remains successfully employed with 850 Club Credit for at least **30 days**.



All working time must be properly tracked using the company's approved time-tracking system.



Additional hours must be approved before they are worked.



Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:



* Have previous recruiting or hiring experience

* Have experience using OnlineJobs.ph

* Are comfortable interviewing candidates

* Have strong written and spoken English

* Can identify strong candidates quickly

* Are extremely organized

* Follow instructions carefully

* Communicate consistently

* Are comfortable rejecting applicants who don't meet requirements

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Understand that quality matters more than the number of applications received



Experience recruiting salespeople, customer service representatives, virtual assistants, or operations staff is a major plus.



How to Apply

Please submit:



1. Reply to job posting with the Subject Line: IM YOUR RECRUITER

2. Your resume

3. A short description of your recruiting experience

4. The types of positions you have recruited for

5. How many candidates you typically screen before recommending someone for an interview

6. A short video via google drive or loom video link recording introducing yourself

7. Your current availability



Applications that do not follow instructions, will not be considered.

title: CURRICULUM TEAM — WRITERS, EDITORS & DIRECTOR: PART TIME / MAY EXPAND
description:
Good Curriculum Does Not Write Itself.



Position Summary

Elorae supports education programs in Korea, including Leaders Academy, where students study English, writing, speech, and competitive debate. The teaching happens live. The curriculum behind it has to be equally strong.



We are building a real Curriculum team, not hiring one generic writer. We want people who can write, edit, organize, and improve educational material across several departments. The priority hire is a Curriculum Director who can set standards, review other people's work, allocate projects, and make the entire team better. We are also hiring strong producers who may specialize in one area.



Current roles include:

• Curriculum Director

• Curriculum Writer, English and ESL

• Curriculum Writer, Debate

• Curriculum Writer, Speech

• Copyeditor



You do not need to fit only one box. If you are genuinely strong in more than one role, say so. Combined roles are welcome.



What This Team Does

Our curriculum is used by real teachers and real students. Work may include lesson plans, student handouts, textbooks, debate preparation materials, speech units, writing prompts, teacher guides, activity sheets, assessment material, and revisions to existing content.



Writers need to understand audience. A worksheet for a younger English learner cannot read like a senior high debate chapter. A speech lesson should not feel like a debate lesson with different labels. Good curriculum is not just grammatically correct. It has a purpose, a level, a sequence, and a classroom reality.



The Curriculum Director role is different. The Director is expected to judge quality, not simply produce pages. You should be able to look at several pieces of work, identify what is wrong, explain the standard, d
 what needs revision, and assign work intelligently across people with different strengths.



Who This Is For

For writing and editing roles, we are interested in people with backgrounds in education, English, ESL, communications, writing, editing, speech, debate, or adjacent fields. Teaching experience is useful because classroom instincts matter. Excellent written English is essential.



For the Curriculum Director, we are especially interested in candidates who have already been responsible for other people's academic output: academic heads, curriculum coordinators, department leaders, senior teachers, editors, school administrators, or similar roles. Years of experience alone are not enough. We need judgment.



Speech and debate experience is a major advantage for the Debate and Speech seats. Korean ability is useful but not required.



A Word About Your Setup

This is remote work. You need your own laptop or desktop, a stable connection of at least 30 Mbps download with acceptable latency, and a workspace where you can focus and join video calls when needed. We work on Korea Standard Time and some overlap with KST business hours is required.



Hours and Payment

These are part-time roles that can expand based on performance and team need. Strong candidates may hold more than one responsibility.



Paid probation begins at 5,000 KRW per hour. The initial ramp is intentionally small so both sides can test fit and real output. Longer-term compensation may shift toward output-based pay depending on the role and the work being produced.



September Philippines Interviews

We will conduct full in-person interview days in Cebu on September 22 and Manila on September 24. Strong applicants who can attend one of those days should make sure their current city is clear in the application. The jobs themselves are remote.



Application Process

Complete the VA application form:





Choose Curriculum and rank the roles that best fit you. Include your CV. If you have curriculum, writing, editing, teaching, debate, or academic work samples, include a portfolio or Drive link. Strong samples matter more than a polished cover letter.



Attentiveness Test

Write "Standards" in your subject line so we know you read the full posting.



Warning

If you use AI to produce generic educational filler and cannot tell whether the result is actually good, this is not the role for you.



If you are applying for Director but your experience is only producing your own work, be prepared to explain how you would evaluate, reject, revise, and allocate the work of others.



If your written English is weak, the application will not advance.

title: Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time
description:
Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant – Part-Time, Growth Opportunity



We are a small but growing U.S.-based creative brand looking for a smart, highly organized, and proactive Executive Assistant / Creative Operations Assistant to join our team.



This role will work directly with the Founder and requires a high level of organization, discretion, accountability, and follow-through. You will help the Founder stay organized, keep priorities moving, and ensure that important administrative, financial, client, and creative tasks do not fall through the cracks.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role. We are looking for someone multi-talented, resourceful, and comfortable wearing different hats in a growing business. One day you may be following up on an invoice or organizing QuickBooks records, and the next you may be scheduling social media content, updating a Canva graphic, or helping coordinate a client project.



The position will begin part-time, with the opportunity to gradually transition into a full-time role as the business grows and responsibilities increase.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Working directly with the Founder to manage priorities, schedules, reminders, and follow-ups

- Helping maintain strong organization across the business and proactively identifying items requiring attention

- Providing administrative and executive support

- Assisting with client communication and tracking outstanding items

- Using QuickBooks Online for basic bookkeeping, invoice management, expense categorization, and payment tracking

- Organizing business documents, receipts, invoices, and records

- Helping manage and schedule content across Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube, and other platforms

- Writing and proofreading captions and basic marketing content

- Using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools for basic content editing

- Organizing photos, videos, and other digital assets

- Assisting with research and other operational tasks

- Following through on assigned tasks without requiring constant reminders



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



- Exceptionally organized and able to keep track of multiple priorities at once

- Able to anticipate needs rather than waiting to be told what to do

- Proficient in QuickBooks Online

- Comfortable managing social media content

- Familiar with Canva, CapCut, or similar basic editing tools

- Tech-savvy and able to learn new systems quickly

- Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking initiative

- Dependable with strong attention to detail

- Professional, personable, and relatable

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Experienced working with U.S. or other international brands or clients



English Requirement



Mastery-level written and spoken English is required.



You will communicate directly with the Founder, team members, and occasionally clients. You should be able to communicate naturally, professionally, and confidently in English without relying heavily on AI for routine business communication.



Hours & Growth



This role will initially be part-time. We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with the company rather than simply taking on another short-term freelance project.



As the company grows and you demonstrate your capabilities, the position is expected to expand in hours, responsibilities, and compensation, with the potential to become full-time.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and why you believe you would be a good fit for this role.

2. Your experience supporting a founder, executive, or small-business owner.

3. Your experience using QuickBooks Online.

4. Your experience managing social media for a business or brand.

5. The editing/design tools you are comfortable using.

6. Your experience working with U.S. or international clients/brands.

7. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

8. Your expected hourly rate.

9. Links or examples of social media accounts, graphics, videos, or other relevant work you have helped manage.



Important: At the beginning of your application, include the words “Creative EA” so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, take ownership of their work, and become a trusted part of the business.

At Skinnify (www.skinnify.co), we make clothing with built-in resistance - leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more - that turn everyday movements like walking, cooking, or commuting into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to 150,000+ customers – and we're just getting started.



To get a better idea of our company and what it's like to work on our team, check out this short video:


/file/d/1Imn7tqGmLXZxcpNBRI0mxYA6ayPwLT7j/view?usp=sharing



Now, we're looking for a full-time Video Editor (40 hours/week) to bring our ad creatives to life - someone who can take raw footage and turn it into powerful, polished videos that drive sales and build our community.

????????????????????

???? Your Responsibilities

? Edit high-converting video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google

? Bring creative briefs to life with fast, compelling edits that match the hook, angle, and storyline

? Create a variety of formats, from short-form direct response ads to longer-form VSLs and advertorial-style content

? Work closely with content creators, creative strategists, and media buyers to deliver assets that perform

? Collaborate on new ad concepts and contribute creative input during brainstorming

? Stay ahead of platform trends, meme culture, and editing styles to keep our content fresh

? Manage and organize video assets, templates, and versioning for efficient turnaround

? Continuously iterate based on data and feedback to improve performance

????????????????????

???? What We're Looking For

?? DTC E-Commerce Experience – This is a mandatory requirement. You've successfully edited ads for ecommerce brands and understand direct-response marketing

?? Performance-Driven Editing – You know what keeps people watching and what drives clicks, conversions, and purchases

?? High Output Capacity – You can consistently deliver 5-10 creative briefs per week across different formats, from 30-second ads to 2-3+ minute VSLs

?? Fast Turnaround – You can edit quickly without sacrificing quality

?? Strong Visual Taste – Your edits look polished, modern, engaging, and conversion-focused

?? Collaborative Yet Independent – You're great at taking feedback and even better at executing without constant supervision

?? Organized & Detail-Oriented – You don't miss deadlines and your file management is on point

????????????????????

???? Why Join Skinnify?

???? Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your edits will directly influence sales and brand growth.

???? Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One team member went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team.

???? Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking — as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

???? Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls - we cover it. Many team members book calls with founders of major ecommerce brands and industry experts through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co.

?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore together, and actually get to know each other.

? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor.

????????????????????

???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life - his mom, his sister, his friends - wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively - while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk?

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked - so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.

????????????????????

????? Our Products

What started with a single product - leggings with built-in resistance bands - has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more.

We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.

????????????????????

???? Skinnify's Core Values

???? Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone - even the busiest and least motivated.

???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

? Quality – Our products are built to last - high-quality, durable, and reliable.

????????????????????

Ready to edit your way into the future of fitness? Apply now and let's create something powerful.

title: Email Deliverability & Domain Reputation Specialist (GoHighLevel)
description:
We send 50,000+ marketing/transactional
s per week and several thousand SMS messages through GoHighLevel (LC
 + LC Phone). Volume is increasing. We recently had a deliverability i
 that cost us thousands of dollars when webinar registrants stopped receiving event reminders.



We need a true expert — not a generalist
 marketer, not a funnel builder, not a "VA who has done some
." A specialist who can keep our sending infrastructure healthy, run domain warmups properly, monitor reputation daily, and catch problems *before* they cost us money.



---



What You'll Own



- Daily monitoring of domain reputation across Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and blacklist services

- SPF / DKIM / DMARC configuration and ongoing alignment management

- Setting up and warming dedicated sending subdomains

- A2P 10DLC SMS campaign registration and ongoing compliance

- Diagnosing and fixing deliverability i
 quickly

- Running warmup tools (Mailreach / Warmup Inbox / Instantly / Smartlead) for new domains



---



Required Experience



- Hands-on management of high-volume sending (20K+/week or more) on GoHighLevel, Mailgun, SendGrid, or similar

- Proven track record running domain warmup ramps from cold to production volume

- Working knowledge of DNS — you can read and write SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records without help

- Experience using Google Postmaster Tools and Microsoft SNDS in your daily workflow

- A2P 10DLC campaign registration experience (through Twilio or TCR)

- At least one example of a deliverability problem you diagnosed and recovered from



---



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY — generic applications will be rejected)



In your application, answer all five of these questions. Skip any of them and we won't review your application.



1. Explain the difference between SPF *pass* and SPF *alignment*, and why DMARC cares about alignment.

2. Walk me through a 30-day warmup ramp for a brand-new subdomain that needs to handle 50,000
s per week. Tell me Day 1 volumes, Day 30 volumes, who you send to during warmup, and what you monitor daily.

3. What's your exact process for checking sender reputation across Gmail and Outlook? Name the tools and the metrics you track.

4. Have you registered an A2P 10DLC campaign before? Walk me through the brand and campaign registration process. If you haven't done one, say so honestly — but know that this is required for the role.

5. Tell me about a specific time a domain you managed got blocked, blacklisted, or sent to spam. What was the root cause, how did you diagnose it, and what specific steps did you take to recover? "I checked the settings" is not an answer.



---



We pay fairly, we move quickly, and we promote people who deliver. We do not waste time on applicants who exaggerate experience — your work-sample test will expose that fast, so please apply only if you have the actual skill.

title: Dating assistant
description:
Dating Concierge & Dating App Assistant



Katie’s Dating Concierge is a premium dating concierge service helping successful, busy men take the work out of modern dating. We handle everything from dating profile management and daily swiping to conversations, screening matches, and arranging dates.



We are looking for a confident, outgoing and socially intelligent woman to join our team long-term.



This is NOT a typical social media or customer service position. You will be communicating with real people on dating apps and with our clients, so you need to be naturally good at conversation, flirting, reading people, and creating genuine chemistry.



What you’ll be doing



Dating App Management



* Manage clients’ dating app profiles and swipe through potential matches.

* Match with women who are a good fit for the client.

* Start and maintain conversations with matches.

* Flirt naturally and confidently while keeping conversations engaging.

* Get to know the women and determine whether they are a good potential match for the client.

* Move conversations toward setting up an actual date.

* Keep track of conversations, matches, and dates.

* Represent the client professionally and in a way that feels natural — the goal is to make the interaction feel authentic, not robotic.



Client Communication



* Communicate directly with our male clients.

* Help onboard new clients and make them feel comfortable using the service.

* Give clients regular updates about their dating activity, matches and progress.

* Answer questions and communicate throughout the dating process.

* Build a comfortable, positive relationship with clients.



Because you will be representing Katie, you should have a warm, confident and slightly flirty communication style with clients as well. Our clients should feel comfortable, appreciated and excited about the service — never embarrassed or awkward about having someone help them with dating.



The ideal candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has perfect or near-perfect English and excellent communication skills.

* Has a **clear, natural English accent and is very easy to understand.

* Is confident speaking English — you must be comfortable sending voice messages and speaking with clients.

* Knows how to **flirt naturally and keep conversations fun and engaging.

* Is comfortable talking to both men and women.

* Has strong social skills and can read the tone of a conversation.

* Is outgoing, confident and not shy.

* Understands dating, attraction and modern dating culture.

* Ideally has personal experience with dating apps and understands how people actually communicate on them.

* Can keep multiple conversations organized without losing track of details.

* Is reliable, mature and professional.

* Is comfortable representing someone else online and staying consistent with their personality and communication style.

* Has a good sense of humor and knows how to make people feel comfortable.

* Is looking for a serious, long-term position, not a temporary side job.



Important



Personality is extremely important for this role.



We don't want someone who simply knows how to type messages. You need to understand how to create attraction, how to flirt, how to keep someone interested, how to move a conversation forward, and how to make people feel good talking to you.



If you are naturally charming, confident and social, you will probably enjoy this job.



Schedule



* Tuesday – Saturday

* 5 hours per day

* 25 hours per week

* Working according to Toronto time (EST/EDT)

* Fully remote / online



Pay

$5 CAD/hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for someone reliable who wants to grow with the company.



 Requirements



* Laptop/computer

* Reliable, fast Wi-Fi

* VPN

* Quiet environment where you can communicate professionally

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Ability to send voice messages

* Availability Tuesday–Saturday during the agreed working hours

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable using dating apps and communicating online



How to apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous work experience, especially anything related to dating, customer service, sales, social media, communication or online work.

3. Why you think you would be good at this position.

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself in English. We specifically want to hear your English, pronunciation and communication style, so please do not skip this step.



 If you read the entire job description, include the word “king” in your response message.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Dating App Test



We want to see how you naturally flirt and start conversations. Based on the profiles below, write the first message you would send.



1. Dani, 28



“I can’t date Theo Von so I’m here instead”

Graphic Designer

“I’m stronger than I look”

“I can beat you at being early for everything”



Your opener: _______



2. Miri, 26



“Carrot cake defender”

“Message me if you also love… carrot cake”

University of Toronto

Leo



Your opener: _______



3. Ray, 31



Senior Manager in Consulting

“Blindfold me and tell me 60h work week isn’t healthy 🥱”

“First date wish list: Tennis pls play tennis with me 🥹”

Has a dog



Your opener: _______



4. Follow-up



Her profile: “Drinks on me if you guess where I’m from.”



We sent: “How about drinks on me, and you tell me where you’re from? 😊”



She replied: “Lmao great workaround”



What would you reply? _______



We are looking for messages that are short, natural, playful and flirty — something that would genuinely make the person want to respond.



Please do not use ChatGPT or AI for this test. We want to see how YOU communicate.

- Following up with caregiver applicants

- Helping coordinate interviews and next steps

- Maintaining organized recruitment records

- Supporting communication between Recruiting, HR, Scheduling, and Operations



### Become Part of the Homecare Operations Team



This position provides exposure to multiple parts of a growing homecare organization.



You may assist with:



- Customer service

- Sales support

- Marketing follow-up

- Scheduling

- Care coordination

- Caregiver recruitment

- Administrative tasks
