title: Copywriter - Linkedin Ghostwriter
description:
We are looking for a strong writer, clear thinker and creative communicator to join our team and support our LinkedIn marketing work.



We work with business owners and professionals to help them build their authority on LinkedIn, create engaging content, grow their networks and turn relationships into genuine business opportunities.



This is a varied role combining:



- LinkedIn content writing

- Story-based copywriting

- LinkedIn graphic creation

-
 relationship building and follow-up



You do not need to already be a LinkedIn expert.



Training will be provided on our LinkedIn strategy, content frameworks, storytelling approach and conversation/outreach processes.



However, you must already be a strong writer with the ability to understand information quickly and communicate it clearly.



We are particularly interested in someone who can take a complicated subject and make it feel simple.



An engineering, technical, analytical or other structured-thinking background would be a strong advantage.



1. LinkedIn Content Writing



A major part of your role will be writing LinkedIn content for different businesses and professionals.



You may be given:



- Interview or meeting transcripts

- Voice notes

- Client stories

- Business information

- Rough ideas and notes

- Videos or podcasts

- Existing marketing material



Your job is not simply to summarise this information.



You need to be able to understand the material, identify what is interesting and turn it into a strong LinkedIn post.



We are particularly interested in story-based business writing.



You should naturally think about questions such as:



- What is the story here?

- What makes this interesting?

- Why would the reader care?

- What is the business insight?

- How can I explain this simply?

- How can I make this sound like the person I'm writing for?



We are NOT looking for generic content that follows the same "hook + three tips + CTA" formula every time.



The writing should feel human, specific and interesting.



You will receive training in our LinkedIn content methodology, but strong writing ability is essential before you start.



2. Creating LinkedIn Graphics



Creating graphics is a regular and important part of this role.



You will be responsible for creating the visual content that accompanies LinkedIn posts.



This may include:



- Single-image LinkedIn graphics

- Quote or statement graphics

- Simple branded graphics

- Simple diagrams

- Thumbnail-style graphics



You should be comfortable using Canva or similar design software.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer.



In fact, we generally prefer simple designs.



What matters is that you have good visual judgement and can understand the main message of a post and communicate that idea visually without making the design cluttered or complicated.



Experience creating LinkedIn graphics or YouTube thumbnails would be a strong advantage.



3. Relationship-Building
s



You will also help us reconnect with people with whom we already have business relationships.



You may be given access to previous
 conversations and asked to understand:



- Who the person is

- What they do

- How we know them

- What we previously discussed

- Where the relationship or conversation stopped

- What opportunities may exist to reconnect

- What would be a genuine reason to contact them again



You will then draft a personalised
 to restart the conversation.



This is not mass
 marketing.



We don't want generic templates being sent to hundreds of people.



You need to be able to read previous conversations, understand context and write something that feels natural, personal and relevant to that particular relationship.



4. LinkedIn Outreach & Conversations



Another part of the role will be helping us build relationships through LinkedIn.



This may include:



- Identifying relevant people to connect with

- Sending personalised connection messages

- Starting conversations

- Responding to messages

- Following up naturally

- Maintaining conversations over time

- Recognising potential business opportunities

- Helping move appropriate conversations towards a call



We will provide training on our approach. The goal is to have genuine conversations that build trust and relationships.



Previous experience in sales, business development, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service or LinkedIn outreach would therefore be an advantage.



Who We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this role are writing ability, comprehension and clear thinking.



You should be someone who can receive a lot of information, understand what actually matters and communicate it simply.



You should:



- Be an excellent written English communicator

- Write naturally and conversationally

- Understand storytelling

- Be able to identify a good story from raw information

- Understand complicated ideas and simplify them

- Be curious and willing to research unfamiliar subjects

- Have strong attention to detail

- Be able to understand different businesses relatively quickly

- Be able to write in different people's voices

- Have good visual judgement

- Be comfortable creating graphics in Canva or similar tools

- Be comfortable communicating with people online

- Be open to feedback and training

- Be organised and able to manage multiple pieces of content



We would particularly value someone with an analytical, engineering, technical, scientific, financial or similarly structured-thinking background.



Your ability to understand complex subjects is important.



LinkedIn Experience



Previous LinkedIn experience is a big advantage, but it is not essential.



If you have previously:



- Written LinkedIn posts

- Ghostwritten for founders or business owners

- Managed LinkedIn accounts

- Created LinkedIn graphics

- Created LinkedIn carousels

- Conducted LinkedIn outreach

- Managed LinkedIn conversations



Please include examples when you apply.



However, if you haven't worked specifically with LinkedIn but you are an exceptional writer with strong business comprehension, we would still like to hear from you.



What We Will Teach You



We will provide training and examples to help you understand:



- How we write LinkedIn content

- How we identify stories

- How we structure different types of LinkedIn posts

- How we write in a client's voice

- How we create LinkedIn graphics

- How we build professional networks

- How we start conversations

- How we follow up without being pushy

- How we move appropriate conversations towards business calls



We are not expecting someone to arrive knowing our entire process.



We are looking for someone with the underlying ability to become excellent at it.



How to Apply



Please do not send only a CV or a generic application.



We want to see how you think and communicate.



Please include the following with your application:



1. Writing Samples



Send us 2–3 examples of your best writing.



We would particularly like to see business writing that tells a story rather than purely promotional copy.



LinkedIn posts are ideal, but articles,
s, scripts, social media posts or other business content are also welcome.



2. Simplifying a Complex Subject



Please show us one example where you took something relatively complicated and explained it in a simple, easy-to-understand way.



This is particularly important to us.



3. Design Samples



Please include examples of graphics you have personally created.



These could include:



LinkedIn graphics

Carousels

Social media graphics

YouTube thumbnails

Infographics

Other simple business content



Please tell us which parts you personally created.



4. LinkedIn Experience



If you have written LinkedIn posts or managed LinkedIn accounts before, please send us links, screenshots or samples.



If you haven't, that's okay. Just tell us that you haven't.



5. Sales / Outreach Experience



Briefly tell us about any experience you've had with:



Sales

Business development

LinkedIn outreach

Lead generation

Appointment setting

Customer conversations



Again, this is an advantage rather than an absolute requirement.



6. Tell Us About You



In a few sentences, tell us:



What is your background, and why do you think you would be particularly good at understanding complex businesses and turning their ideas into simple, interesting content?



7. Availability and Hours



How many hours are you wanting to work per week? And, what's your expected monthly rate?



One Final Note



Please don't worry if you don't meet every requirement listed above.



We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already spent years as a "LinkedIn specialist."



We are looking for someone who has the foundations we can build on:



Strong writing.

Clear thinking.

Storytelling ability.

Curiosity.

Good visual judgement.

Attention to detail.

And the ability to communicate naturally with people.



If you have those qualities, we can teach you the rest.

title: Admin Project Manager (Tech) — Moodap
description:
After reviewing this job post, please send a video to my WhatsApp at (212)
. 



Only responses with videos introducing yourself and telling us why you would be the best fit for this opportunity, which is a great opportunity and will turn into much more, will be accepted and responded to.



Schedule



Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time. Full-time.



About the Role



Moodap is a live, mood-based discovery platform, and we're scaling the dev team. We need a Project Manager/Admin who takes full ownership of organizing our two developers and keeping the entire build tracked, structured, and moving — every task, every bug, every priority, every update, accounted for and visible at all times.



This is not a passive scheduling or note-taking role. You will be the one holding the team accountable to deadlines and process. You report directly to the founder, but on a day-to-day basis, you run the organizational side of this project like a director — not a soft-spoken assistant waiting to be told what to do next.



What You'll Own

Full task and project tracking for the development team inside Full Loop CRM — timelines, pipeline stages, notes, and all team communications live in one place, always current.

Translating developer updates into clear, organized status reports for the founder — no vague summaries, no missed items.

Driving daily/weekly check-ins with the two developers to confirm progress against priorities and deadlines, and flagging slippage immediately rather than letting it slide.

Structuring the backlog: intake bugs, feature requests, and priorities; assign clear ownership and due dates; keep everything ranked and visible.

Enforcing process — the developers focus on building; you make sure nothing falls through the cracks, nothing is undocumented, and nothing is "somewhere in a Slack thread" instead of tracked properly.

Escalating problems the moment you see them, not after they've become bigger problems.

Tools

Full Loop CRM (primary system of record — project timeline, pipeline, notes, and all communications)

You'll be added to an internal admin chat with our existing admin team, who will train you on our CRM setup, workflows, and standards during onboarding.

What We're Looking For

Real project management experience, ideally with a software/tech development team — you understand sprints, bug tracking, and how dev priorities get set, even if you don't code yourself.

A director's mindset: organized, assertive, and comfortable holding people accountable, including pushing back when something isn't tracked properly or a deadline is at risk.

Not a pushover. We need someone who will own the room, not just take notes in it.

Excellent written communication — clear, structured, and direct.

Comfortable working independently once processes are set, and proactive about flagging gaps before they're asked about.

Full-time availability during EST business hours.

How We Work



Direct, honest, and blunt communication is the standard here — with the developers and with the founder. We care about solutions, not blame. If something isn't working, we want to hear it early and clearly, with a plan attached.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor for Medical Clinics (Capable of Batch Editing)
description:
Read this whole post before applying. The instructions at the bottom are part

of the test.



WHO WE ARE



Novaris Global. We run paid advertising for private medical clinics, mostly

plastic surgery and aesthetics. Our clients are in Singapore and we are

expanding. Our ads run on Meta. When they work, the clinic books consultations.

When they don't, we lose money. That is the entire scoreboard.



THE MAIN THING YOU WOULD BE DOING



Once or twice a month a doctor sits down and records for 30 to 60 minutes

straight. He works through a stack of scripts, flubs lines, restarts, goes off

on tangents, repeats himself, and says something better on the third take than

he did on the first.



It is one long messy file.



Out of that single file we need 30 to 60 finished Meta video ads.



Not 30 exports of the same cut. Thirty to sixty ads that each open differently,

run differently, and feel like they came from different creatives. That is how

Meta finds a winner, and it is the actual skill we are hiring for.



That means you:



- Watch the whole file and map what is really in there

- D
 where one ad ends and the next one starts

- Pick the strongest take of every line, not the first one

- Cut the sentences that add nothing. Warm ups, throat clearing, repeated

  ideas, and the line that is technically true but kills the pace

- Reorder freely. If the best hook is something he said at minute 34, that line

  goes to second zero

- Recombine. The same three sentences in a different order, with a different

  opening line and a different first ten seconds, is a different ad

- Build each one properly. On screen text in the first two seconds, burned in

  captions throughout, a lower third with his name and clinic, b-roll, sound

  design, graphics, end card



THE OTHER TWO KINDS OF WORK



Not everything arrives as a batch. Some weeks you get a single clip and a brief

and we need one sharp ad out of it by tomorrow.



And some weeks you get a video sales letter. Long form, five to twenty minutes,

a doctor walking through an argument end to end. Completely different edit. The

hook still has to land in the first few seconds, but now you are holding

attention for fifteen minutes instead of thirty seconds, which means pacing,

chapter beats, visual variety, and knowing exactly where a viewer gets bored

and what to put there. If you have never cut long form, say so honestly. If you

have, lead with it.



EVERY AD HAS TO FEEL DIFFERENT



This is the part almost every editor fails.



When you cut 40 ads from one recording, the lazy version is one template with

40 different hooks dropped in. Meta sees through it, the audience sees through

it, and the account stalls.



We want visible variety across the set. Different caption styles. Different

graphic treatments. One ad that leans on text animation, one that is almost

bare and lets him talk, one built around a simple diagram, one with heavier

b-roll, one that opens on a graphic before he appears. Different rhythms.

Different energy.



Someone scrolling should never think they have already seen this ad. Play

around. Have opinions. Show us range.



THE LINE YOU CANNOT CROSS WHILE DOING IT



This is a surgeon, not a dropshipper. Every one of those 40 ads still has to

look expensive, clean, and calm. Variety in style, never variety in standards.



No meme zooms. No shake. No cartoon sound effects. No AI voice. No stock

footage of a family smiling at sunset. If an edit would look at home selling a

phone case, it is wrong for us.



The hard version of this job is doing both at once. Retention editing that

actually holds attention, inside a look a private surgeon would put his name

on. Most editors can do one or the other.



Medical advertising in Singapore is also regulated, and moves that are normal

everywhere else are illegal there. No before and after footage. No testimonials.

No "best" or "guaranteed." No countdowns or scarcity. We give you the full rule

sheet on day one, but you have to be someone who follows a rule sheet exactly,

every time, without being reminded.



WHAT YOU NEED TO ALREADY KNOW



- Hook rate and hold rate, and what actually moves them. If your answer to a

  weak hook is "add a zoom," this role is not for you

- The first two seconds carry on screen text, because most of Meta watches on

  mute

- A retention beat every few seconds. A cut, a caption change, a graphic, a

  b-roll insert. Something has to change or they are gone

- Captions readable at arm's length on a phone, inside Meta's safe zones, not

  sitting under the interface

- Sound design that supports the point instead of decorating it. A whoosh on

  every cut is amateur work

- 9:16 at 1080x1920, correct loudness, correct export settings, and a first

  frame that is not a blink

- Written English strong enough to judge a sentence. You are d
 which of

  a surgeon's sentences survive. That takes real comprehension, not just an ear

  for rhythm



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



If you can write, say so. If you can watch a raw recording and tell us "he

never said the thing that would make this ad work, here is what he should say

next time," that is worth more to us than another year of Premiere experience,

and it changes what we pay you.



THE SETUP



- Full time, 40 hours a week

- Your own machine that handles 4K without taking an hour to export

- Reliable internet, because you are moving large files

- Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, whatever you like. We care about

  the output, not your toolkit

- You work directly with me. Small team, no layers, fast decisions



HOW THIS STARTS



A paid trial. Real footage, a real brief, real money for your time.



We are not going to pretend a reel tells us anything. Plenty of great reels

were cut by somebody else. The trial tells us what you actually do when a messy

file lands in your lap.



If the work comes back genuinely excellent, and we mean excellent and not

acceptable, we move straight to a full time offer. If it does not, you keep the

money and we part on good terms.



BEFORE YOU D
 THIS IS TOO MUCH WORK



Yes, this application asks more of you than the other posts on this site. That

is deliberate. So here is the honest math on what you are applying to.



We are hiring one person, once. Whoever we pick stops applying for jobs.



You are not applying to a task. You are applying to a department that does not

exist yet, with your name on it. Right now every video for every client we have

runs through one folder and one to do list. The person we hire builds what

replaces that. You set the standard. You make the templates every editor after

you works from. You hire those editors and review their work instead of doing

it. Head of Video, across every account, fully in house. Not a freelancer we

message when something comes up. On the team, in the meetings, in the decisions.



You will also see the money side, which almost no editor anywhere gets to see.

Hook rate on your cuts. Cost per lead. Which clinic booked how many

consultations off which edit. That feedback loop is the entire difference

between an editor who is good at software and an editor who is worth whatever

they ask for, for the rest of their career. We will hand it to you.



And here is why we can pay for that. Our clients do not pay us a flat fee. We

take a share of the revenue we generate for them. When your ad wins, we do not

save money, we make more of it. So we would far rather pay one exceptional

editor well beyond what this platform normally pays than hire five cheap ones

and manage them. Your ceiling here is not an hourly rate. It grows with the

accounts you are cutting for.



A few hours today. If we are right about each other, you will look back on this

as the best few hours you ever spent on an application.



If none of that moves you, please do not apply. We would rather read ten

serious applications than a hundred lazy ones.



HOW TO APPLY



Do all four. Applications missing any of them get deleted unread.



Two of these are what we actually judge: the ads you have already cut, and what

you cut for us. The other two take a minute each. Spend your time on the first

two.



1. Make THUMBSTOP the first word of your message.



2. Send three to five direct response video ads you personally cut.



   What counts: ads that actually ran as paid media on Meta, TikTok, or

   YouTube. Something built to make a stranger take an action.



   What does not count and will get your application closed: showreels,

   montages, wedding films, YouTube intros, vlogs, corporate brand videos,

   event recaps, anything cut to music with no message.



   Do not send a reel. Send the ads themselves, full length, exactly as they

   ran. We watch from the first frame, because the first frame is the job.



   For each one, one line covering:

   - Who it was for and what it was selling

   - Whether it ran as paid media, and roughly what it spent if you know

   - Any numbers you have. Hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per result. If you

     have none, say none. We would rather hear that than a guess

   - What you personally did on it, honestly. If you cut it start to finish,

     say so. If you did captions and graphics on somebody else's assembly, say

     that instead. We will find out either way, and the honest answer has never

     cost anyone the job



   If your strongest work is under an NDA, send what you can and tell us what

   we are missing.



3. Cut something from this file:



   



   THE MINIMUM is five seconds. Just the hook. The opening that would stop

   someone scrolling, with whatever on screen text, sound, graphics, and

   cutting you think earns those five seconds. Start from any moment in the

   file you want. A genuinely strong five seconds is enough to get you

   shortlisted.



   THE FULL AD IS BETTER. If you send a finished ad cut from this file, hook

   through to end card with captions all the way, we will watch every second of

   it and you go to the top of the pile. It is not required. It is an

   opportunity, and the people who take it are usually the people we hire.



   Either way, in two or three sentences: why that moment, why that treatment,

   and what you cut out and why.



   Do not post this footage anywhere public.



4. Answer this in writing. You receive a 45 minute file of a surgeon recording

   what he thinks are eight ads. He goes off script constantly and the single

   best line he says is at minute 38. What do you do in your first hour, before

   you cut anything? And how do you get 40 genuinely different ads out of it

   instead of 40 versions of one?



Shortlisted applicants go straight to a paid trial on real client footage.

title: Instagram Content VA — 6 carousel posts a day (about 1 hour/day, 7 days a week, long-term)
description:
I run an Instagram page that turns viral social media posts into "card news" carousels: a cover photo with a headline, a screenshot-style slide of the original post and its top comments, and a short caption. We publish 6 posts every day.



You will not design from scratch. We have our own web app that does most of the work: paste a link and it builds the slides and caption in about a minute. Your job is to run that pipeline every day, check that everything looks right, and get all 6 posts scheduled on time.



What you will do every day:



Open the queue: 6 links, added by me.

For each link, generate the carousel in our app and check it against the checklist: headline fits on two lines and nothing is cut off; cover photo matches the story, and if not, regenerate it or pick another photo; screenshot slide shows the post, counts and comments correctly; all slides and the caption are complete, with no blank or broken parts.

Send post for approval through the app and message me on WhatsApp.

Once approved, schedule it in Meta Business Suite at the agreed time slot and mark it scheduled in the app.



Who I am looking for:



Has scheduled Instagram posts before, ideally with Meta Business Suite or a scheduler like Later or Buffer.

Detail-oriented. This job is mostly checking, and a wrong cover photo or a cut-off headline going live is the one thing we cannot have. If you enjoy spotting the one wrong thing on a page, you will like this.

Reliable every single day, including weekends and holidays, without reminders. If you need a day off, you tell me in advance.

Communicates clearly and quickly on WhatsApp.

Reliable internet and a laptop or desktop. A phone alone is not enough.

Bonus: interest in Korean online culture or trending topics. Korean language is not required.



What you get:



Steady, long-term daily work with the same client

A tool that does the heavy lifting, so the work stays consistent and predictable

A clear approval flow: you always know what is waiting on you and what is waiting on me



How to apply:



Reply with the subject line "Carousel VA" and answer these, briefly:



One Instagram or social media account you have helped schedule or manage, and exactly what you did.

Describe how you would make sure 6 scheduled posts a day go out with zero mistakes, 7 days a week.

Which posting times do you think work best for a Korean audience, and why?

What time of day (Korea time) you would do this work.



Applications without the subject line will not be read. Shortlisted applicants get a short paid trial: I will send you three links, you produce and schedule them using the app, and we talk afterwards.

OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

title: E-commerce Business Development & Partnerships Specialist — Shopify Sellers & Referrals
description:
We are a China-based product sourcing and fulfillment company helping ecommerce sellers with their China supply chain needs.

We’re looking for a business development and partnerships specialist to help us connect with Shopify store owners and sellers on other ecommerce platforms, primarily in the US and Europe.

Our goal is to bring more qualified sellers into paid trials and long-term cooperation with our sourcing and fulfillment team.

We are especially interested in candidates who have worked directly with ecommerce sellers and already have professional relationships that could lead to warm introductions.

WHO WE WANT TO CONNECT WITH

You will develop opportunities through two channels:

1. Direct seller outreach — our main priority

Find and connect with Shopify store owners, independent ecommerce brands, and sellers on other platforms who need China-based sourcing or fulfillment support.

Suitable prospects may be looking for:

- A reliable Chinese supplier or sourcing agent.

- An alternative or backup to their existing supplier.

- Support with product sourcing, supplier coordination, or quality control.

- Dropshipping fulfillment or bulk purchasing.

- Solutions to existing sourcing and fulfillment problems.

Prioritize sellers with active sales or a clear purchasing plan, products our team can support, and a genuine need for our services.

2. Referrals and channel partnerships

Build relationships with dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, course creators, ecommerce agencies, consultants, and community owners whose students or clients may need our services.

The purpose of these partnerships is to generate relevant seller introductions and customer opportunities.

EXPERIENCE AND RELATIONSHIPS WE VALUE

Have you worked with Shopify sellers as a store operator, customer service representative, virtual assistant, account manager, or sourcing coordinator? That experience could be highly relevant to this role.

We particularly value candidates who:

- Have supported Shopify or other ecommerce sellers with store operations, customer service, order processing, product sourcing, or supplier coordination.

- Have communicated directly with store owners or business decision-makers.

- Understand common seller problems involving suppliers, orders, shipping, and customer satisfaction.

- Maintain professional relationships with sellers who may need China-based sourcing and fulfillment.

- Know dropshipping educators, Shopify coaches, agencies, or community owners who could introduce suitable sellers.

- Can arrange warm introductions with the other person’s permission.

You do not need a large network. A few relevant, trusted relationships can be valuable. Candidates without existing connections are also welcome if they can demonstrate strong customer development skills.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research and qualify potential ecommerce customers and referral partners.

- Identify and contact relevant owners and decision-makers.

- Where appropriate, approach your existing professional network to explore potential introductions.

- Send personalized outreach through appropriate channels, including
, LinkedIn, and relevant online communities.

- Handle initial replies and follow up consistently.

- Understand prospects’ products, sourcing arrangements, order volume, target markets, and supply chain needs.

- Arrange qualified conversations and coordinate quotation requests with our China team.

- Help interested sellers move toward trial orders and ongoing cooperation.

- Develop referral relationships with educators, agencies, and community owners.

- Maintain accurate records of contacts, conversations, opportunities, and next steps in a shared spreadsheet or CRM.

- Report which approaches generate qualified conversations and customers.

Our China team will confirm product feasibility, approve pricing and service commitments, and handle sourcing and fulfillment operations.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly in English during business conversations.

- Relevant experience in ecommerce support, B2B outreach, lead generation, appointment setting, sales, or partnership development.

- Familiarity with Shopify, ecommerce operations, dropshipping, or China supply chains.

- Ability to identify customer needs and qualify opportunities—not simply collect contact lists.

- Strong organization, consistent follow-up, and accurate recordkeeping.

- Ability to work independently and learn our services.

- Good judgment when communicating with potential customers.

Please do not promise prices, delivery times, guarantees, or services that our team has not approved.

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

We evaluate:

- Relevant, qualified seller conversations.

- Warm introductions to suitable sellers and referral partners.

- Qualified quotation requests and trial-order opportunities.

- New paying customers and repeat cooperation.

- Accurate records and consistent follow-up.

Contact-list size and message volume alone are not measures of success. We will review results alongside our team’s pricing, response times, and delivery performance.

SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

- Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week.

- Agreed overlap with our China team during business hours, with flexibility for conversations in the target market.

- Base pay: USD $500–$800 per month, depending on experience.

- Additional performance bonuses and successful customer referral commissions under a written agreement.

- Referral qualification, attribution, and payment terms will be agreed before outreach begins.

- Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid practical assessment.

- Initial paid 30-day engagement, with the opportunity for long-term cooperation.

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with SELLER PARTNER and answer these questions:

1. Relevant experience: Have you provided services to Shopify or other ecommerce sellers? Describe your responsibilities and whether you communicated directly with owners or decision-makers.

2. Customer development: Describe one relevant outreach, sales, or referral project. What did you personally do, and what results did you achieve? Anonymized examples are welcome. If you have not done this before, please say so.

3. Existing relationships: Do you currently know sellers, educators, coaches, or agency owners who might be open to an introduction? Describe the relationship, how recently you were in contact, and why our services could be relevant. Do not provide names or private contact details at this stage.

4. Outreach sample: Write a four-sentence message to a Shopify seller who already has a supplier. Use only the company information in this post; do not assume specific prices, delivery times, or guarantees.

5. Availability and expectations: State your weekly availability, expected compensation, and whether your strengths are direct seller outreach, warm introductions, channel partnerships, or a combination.

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph. No live outreach or introductions are required during the application process.

We respect your professional relationships. Do not share confidential customer lists, private account information, or materials belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Texas-based plaintiff-side personal injury firm seeking an experienced Litigation Paralegal. This is a fully remote position for a candidate who can independently manage a case from the moment a lawsuit is filed through trial preparation, with no training period required.



What We're Looking For



We are hiring specifically for post-filing litigation work — from petition through trial. This is not a pre-suit or intake-focused role, and we are not seeking anyone who needs to be trained on the fundamentals of personal injury litigation.



Minimum Qualifications



At least 3 years of demonstrated plaintiff-side personal injury litigation experience

Working knowledge of litigation from petition through trial

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure and Texas law as it applies to personal injury litigation

Direct, hands-on experience with case management software

Experience managing a high-volume active caseload of filed litigation matters



Duties and Responsibilities



Draft original petitions and initiate new lawsuits

Draft and file amended petitions

Draft discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission

Draft responses to discovery requests received from opposing counsel

Complete Defendant's Written Discovery Questionnaires (DWQs)

Identify appropriate expert witnesses for each case

Prepare and file designation of experts

Prepare initial disclosures

Prepare for and coordinate depositions, including scheduling, exhibit preparation, and logistics with opposing counsel, court reporters, and clients

Track and manage all case deadlines

Communicate directly with clients, opposing counsel, and insurance adjusters as needed



Schedule



This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be resourceful and capable of ensuring physical tasks get done even while working remotely — for example, coordinating with in-office staff to have documents printed, organized, or delivered, or arranging third-party legal support services to handle physical trial preparation, exhibit production, or courier needs. The ability to problem-solve and make these things happen without being physically present is essential. Candidates must be available and reachable approximately 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. Some scheduling flexibility is available for the right candidate.



International applicants: this schedule is fixed to Central Time (United States), not your local time zone. If you are located in the Philippines, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time falls at approximately 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine time, meaning this would be an overnight shift for you. Please confirm you understand this before applying and that you are able and willing to work these hours on your local clock.



Compensation



Salary is commensurate with experience. Please include your minimum compensation requirement with your application.



To Apply



Please include the following with your application:



Number of years of plaintiff-side litigation experience?



Confirmation that you can independently handle litigation work from petition through trial preparation.



Your typical caseload volume and whether managed solo or as part of a team?



Your minimum hourly rate or salary requirement?



Confirmation that you are able to begin work without a training period?



A description of a time you had to ensure a physical task (printing, filing, document delivery, etc.) got completed without being on-site, and how you made it happen?



Confirmation that you are able to work 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday. If you are applying from outside the United States, please confirm you understand what this means in your local time zone and that you are able and willing to work those hours.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
description:
Who We Are:

We are CL Financial (CLFIN . ca), a Toronto-based financial services firm serving families across Ontario and Alberta, with a strong presence in the Filipino community in Canada. We've been around since 2012 and are now in an exciting stage of growth: building new technology, training programs, internal systems, and infrastructure to support where the company is going next.



We're a lean team with ambitious plans, and we care about doing things well: clean systems, clear communication, strong design, and thoughtful execution.



We're not trying to become a huge corporate machine. We want to stay lean, move quickly, and have really capable people doing meaningful work.



About the Role:

We're looking for a Strategic Executive Assistant to work closely with our COO across creative, operational, and strategic projects.



This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll simply be handed a checklist every morning and told what to do. Sometimes you'll get a clear assignment. Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to.



What You'll Do:

Project Support:

- Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers

- Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks



Creative & Communication:

- Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets

- Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs

- Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools

- Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better"



Systems & Operations:

- Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines

- Test new internal tools and identify improvements

- Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work



AI & Technology:

- Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work

- Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly

- Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available



You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more.



Who We're Looking For:

You'll probably thrive here if you:

- Have excellent written English

- Are highly organized and dependable

- Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting)

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can manage multiple projects without losing the details

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Naturally look for better ways to do things

- Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting)



Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome.



Why Work With Us?

- Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making

- Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work

- Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged

- Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business

- Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow

- A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role

- A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans

- A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background)

- The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real)



How to Apply:

If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting.



Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Why this role caught your attention

3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Dedicated Executive & Operations VA
description:
Dedicated Executive & Operations VA



I am looking for a long-term Filipino virtual assistant who is reliable, loyal, available during U.S. working hours, and able to take responsibility for online administrative work without needing constant supervision.



Please read this carefully before applying.



First: Do NOT Send Me a Resume



I do not want a resume.



Do not send me a long employment history, certificates, software lists, or paragraphs telling me how skilled, hardworking, dependable, or experienced you are.



If you send me a resume instead of following the application instructions below, I will delete the application.



I am not interested in how impressive you sound.



I want to know whether you can actually help me.



The Two Most Important Qualities: Reliability and Loyalty



This position requires commitment.



I am not looking for:



* An agency

* An entrepreneur building their own business

* Someone managing many clients at the same time

* Someone who will regularly place another client’s work ahead of mine

* Someone who disappears when things get busy

* Someone who misses deadlines because another client needed them first



If there is a conflict between another client’s deadline and my deadline, and my work regularly becomes secondary, this will not be a good fit.



I need someone who can make a real commitment to our team and our deadlines.



I am looking for a long-term working relationship built on trust, dependability, communication, and loyalty.



Christian Faith and Local Church Involvement Are Required



This is a Christian ministry position.



I serve evangelical, born-again pastors, church leaders, ministry leaders, biblical counselors, and Christian organizations. Because of that, the person assisting me must understand evangelical Christian ministry and have meaningful experience in the life of a local Bible-teaching church.



You must:



* Be a born-again Christian.

* Attend an evangelical, Bible-teaching local church.

* Be actively involved in the life of your church.

* Understand basic evangelical Christian language, ministry culture, and church life.

* Be comfortable communicating with pastors and ministry leaders.

* Be able to represent a Christian ministry appropriately and professionally.



This is not simply a preference. It is directly connected to the work you will be doing and the people we serve.



As part of the interview process, I will ask you to provide:



* The name of your local church.

* The name of your pastor.

* Your church website or public church information.

* A brief description of your involvement in the church.

* A letter of recommendation or endorsement from your pastor confirming that you attend and participate in the local church.



Please do not apply if you are not currently part of an evangelical, Bible-teaching local church.



You Must Work During U.S. Hours



This is not a position where all work can be completed independently while I am asleep.



We need to work together.



You must be available for meaningful portions of the U.S. workday and be willing to communicate live when needed.



There will be:



* Zoom conversations

* Voice conversations

* Real-time questions

* Team meetings

* Deadline discussions

* Project updates



Your schedule must allow you to work effectively with a U.S.-based team.



Fluent Conversational English Is Required



You must be able to have a normal conversation with me in English.



I am not looking for perfect grammar or an American accent.



I do need you to:



* Understand normal conversational English

* Speak comfortably

* Ask clear questions

* Explain problems

* Discuss projects

* Understand instructions

* Participate in Zoom meetings

* Communicate without major language barriers



We will speak regularly.



If spoken English is difficult for you, please do not apply.



I Need Someone Who Takes Work Off My Plate



I am a pastor, professor, ministry leader, and administrator.



I need someone who can receive an assignment, understand the goal, and move it forward.



I do not want to manage every small step.



A good candidate will naturally:



* Take initiative

* Follow through

* Meet deadlines

* Communicate before a deadline is missed

* Research before asking unnecessary questions

* Solve routine problems

* Keep projects organized

* Remember commitments

* Follow up

* Notice unfinished work

* Bring me solutions instead of only problems

* Learn new software when necessary

* Take ownership



I want to be able to say:



“Please take care of this.”



And have confidence that it will actually be taken care of.



Be Honest About Your Skills



Do not exaggerate.



If you tell me you are advanced in a software program or skill, I may ask you to demonstrate it.



I would much rather hear:



“I know the basics, but I would need to learn more.”



Honesty and self-awareness matter more to me than an impressive list of skills.



How to Apply



Do NOT send a resume.



Instead, answer these questions briefly:



1. What other clients or jobs are you currently working for, and approximately how many hours per week do they require?

2. What U.S. hours are you available to work?

3. Are you willing to make our deadlines a priority when work has been assigned to you?

4. Why are you looking for one long-term position rather than managing many clients?

5. Give me one example of an online administrative responsibility you could take completely off my plate.

6. Tell me one skill you are genuinely strong in and one skill you are still developing.

7. What is the name of the local church you currently attend?

8. What is your pastor’s name?

9. Send me the website or public page for your church.

10. Briefly tell me how you are involved in your local church.

11. Are you willing, if you move forward in the interview process, to provide a brief recommendation or endorsement from your pastor confirming your participation in the church?

12. Plan a Zoom meeting with me in English and answering this question:



“If I give you an important assignment with a deadline and you begin running into problems, what will you do?”



Keep your response short.



Following these instructions is part of the interview.



What I Am Looking For



I am looking for someone who can become a trusted member of the team.



Reliability matters.



Loyalty matters.



Christian faith matters.



Local church involvement matters.



Communication matters.



Meeting deadlines matters.



Taking ownership matters.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term position where you can become increasingly valuable to one Christian ministry organization, I would like to hear from you.

title: Stand up comedy editor and content manager
description:
I’m a professional stand-up comedian looking for someone to help me grow my audience on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I have over 100 million views but want to take things to the next level. 



This is NOT just a video editing job.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become obsessed with figuring out how to make my comedy go viral.



And there is one requirement that is more important than anything else:



You MUST genuinely love stand-up comedy.



I don’t mean you’ve seen a few Kevin Hart clips on TikTok.



I want someone who actually watches American stand-up comedy in their free time.



You should have favorite comedians.



You should watch comedy specials.



You should understand why a joke is funny, where the punchline is, and why the setup matters.



You should understand sarcasm, irony, wordplay, crowd work, cultural references, and comedic timing.



This also means your English comprehension needs to be EXCELLENT.



You don’t have to speak perfect English. But you need to understand it at a very high level.



If you don’t genuinely love stand-up comedy, please don’t apply.



WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



I have a large amount of stand-up footage, podcasts, and other long-form content.



Your job will be to find the best moments and turn them into short-form videos that people want to watch and share.



You’ll primarily be creating content for:



* Instagram Reels

* Instagram Trial Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts



We’ll be posting a LOT.



On Instagram alone, I want to test at least 5 Trial Reels per day.



The goal isn’t just to pump out 5 random videos.



We’re going to test constantly and figure out what works.



Which jokes get the most views?



Which opening lines stop people from scrolling?



Which topics perform best?



Which clips generate followers?



Which lengths perform best?



What makes someone watch until the punchline?



What makes someone share a clip with their friend?



I want you paying attention to all of this.



I DON’T WANT SOMEONE WHO JUST FOLLOWS INSTRUCTIONS



At the beginning, I’ll give you a lot of direction.



I’ll show you what I like.



I’ll show you my best-performing content.



I’ll explain my comedy and how I think about clips.



But eventually I want YOU finding the clips.



I want to be able to give you a 60-minute stand-up performance or a 90-minute podcast and have you identify the moments that have the best chance of performing online.



I want you to get to know my comedy so well that you can watch something and immediately think:



“That’s the clip.”



That’s much more valuable to me than someone who is simply good at using editing software.



YOUR REAL JOB IS GROWTH



I don’t care about posting content just so we can say we posted something.



I want views. I want followers. I want fans.



I want someone who gets genuinely excited when a video takes off.



If one video gets 20,000 views and another gets 2,000,000 views, I want you asking WHY.



Was it the joke?



The first three seconds?



The caption?



The length?



The topic?



The editing?



Could we take another clip and package it the same way?



Could we edit the same joke differently and test it again?



You should constantly be looking for patterns and trying to beat our previous results.



YOU’LL GET PAID MORE WHEN WE WIN



In addition to your normal pay, you’ll have the opportunity to earn significant monthly performance bonuses.



The more views and growth our content generates, the more money you can make.



There will be bonuses based on things like:



* Total monthly organic views

* Follower growth

* Individual videos that become breakout hits



I want your incentives aligned with mine.



If you help me build a massive comedy audience, I want this to become a VERY good job for you.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You’ll probably be a great fit if:



* You genuinely love American stand-up comedy

* You regularly watch stand-up specials and comedy clips

* Your English comprehension is excellent

* You understand American humor and cultural references

* You’re good at identifying the funniest/most interesting moment in a longer video

* You have experience editing short-form vertical video

* You understand hooks, retention, pacing, captions, and short-form storytelling

* You understand Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

* You’re comfortable producing and posting a high volume of content

* You like looking at analytics

* You’re competitive

* You experiment instead of doing the same thing over and over

* You’re proactive

* You can work independently

* You want to get REALLY fucking good at social media growth



HOURS



We’ll start at approximately 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week.



The first month will essentially be a paid trial.



If you’re great at this, I would love to turn it into a full-time position.



I’m not looking for someone to edit videos for me for three months.



I’m looking for someone who could potentially work with me for YEARS and become an important part of growing my comedy career.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of these questions:



1. Who are your 5 favorite stand-up comedians?



Do not Google “popular American comedians.” I will be able to tell 😂



2. What is your favorite stand-up special you’ve watched recently and why did you like it?



3. Send me links to 3 short-form videos you’ve personally edited.



4. Tell me about the most successful short-form video you’ve edited. How many views did it get?



5. Why do you think that video performed well?



6. If I gave you a 60-minute stand-up show, how would you d
 which 5 moments should become clips?



7. What editing software do you use?



8. What is your current availability?



And finally:



Start your application with the words “THAT’S THE CLIP” so I know you actually read this entire post.



If you don’t include those words, I won’t read your application.



I’m excited to find someone who loves comedy and wants to build something big with me.

title: Retention & Growth Specialist — Client Feedback Calls (Path to Cold Calling)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Are you a friendly, articulate communicator who's comfortable on the phone with US clients? Rex Visual Services, a real estate media company based in Atlanta, Georgia, is hiring a Part-Time Retention & Growth Specialist to make client feedback calls and help us maintain relationships with our real estate agent clients after their shoots. This is a relationship-based role, not high-pressure sales.



Position Details:



Position: Retention & Growth Specialist — Client Feedback Calls (Path to Cold Calling)

Company: Rex Visual Services

Pay: $10/hour, guaranteed 4 hours/week, plus performance bonuses (see below)

Hours: ~2 hours/day, 2 days/week (e.g. Monday + Thursday or Friday) — light, dedicated part-time schedule



Key Responsibilities:



As our Retention & Growth Specialist, you'll be the friendly voice checking in with our past clients after their shoots. You'll follow a proven call script, and your work directly affects our online reputation and referral pipeline. This is a client-facing role — you'll be speaking with our actual clients, so professionalism and a warm, clear phone presence matter a great deal.



Your responsibilities will include:



Making short (typically 3-5 minute) follow-up calls to past clients using our existing call script

Asking for online reviews and helping clients through the process if needed

Asking whether the client has referred anyone to us, or received a referral from us, and logging the details

Tracking monthly totals for reviews collected and referrals logged in our system (Notion — training provided)

Following a simple weekly cadence: a primary calling day, with a short catch-up day later in the week for anyone who didn't answer



Compensation Structure:



Base pay: $10/hour for a guaranteed 4 hours/week (~$
/month)

Referral Bonus: $10 for every referral you log from a client

Review Bonus: $2 for every confirmed new Google review you help bring in

Realistic total: most months land around $
/month based on our current referral volume



Growth Opportunity:



This role starts with feedback calls, but we're hiring with the intention of growing it. If you perform well, there's a real path to taking on cold-calling work for us as well — with more hours and higher pay. We currently have team members earning $300 to $1,700/month with us, and we want our next hire to grow into a bigger role over time.



We're looking for someone who is friendly, warm, and comfortable speaking on the phone with clients. The best person for this role is someone who can genuinely relate to our clients, follow a script while still sounding natural, and take pride in every call. People will judge our company by how you sound, so professionalism and clear communication matter.



Qualifications:



Fluent, clear spoken English and confidence talking with US-based clients

Comfortable following a script while still sounding natural and warm

Check out our video editing style here: 



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING:

- Property listing videos (1-2 min, 4K a7siii footage plus drone)

- Premiere Pro template, LUTs, MOGRTs

- Strong Premiere Pro skills. After Effects would be great too. If you are a Final Cut Pro editor, please do not apply.

- Strong ear and passion for sound design

- Good English and grammar. Voice-note briefs will be part of the job, so will need to be understood clearly, and you will learn New Zealand buyer and agent culture over time. (It's a bit more humble tone than USA)

- Fast turnarounds, 24 to 48 hours 



WHAT I REALLY CARE ABOUT:

I need to find an editor who loves studying American and Australian real estate reels and applies the techniques to your own work. Who obsesses over cuts, sound design, color, and awesome text effects, but can also do it at high speed. Who loves groundbreaking editing that makes the audience go WOW! 



HOW IT WORKS:

- Trial: 1 paid test edit ($70 USD), full listing video, 48 hour deadline

- Rates (project-based): $70 USD listing video / $80 USD premium reel / $60 USD personal branding reel / 

  $40 USD ASCOT-only (only finishing up the project) / $30 USD sold and coming soon reels

TO APPLY, SEND:

1. Your showreel or a few real estate video samples (or your wildest work)

Cheers,

Louie

title: MOBILE IOS SOFTWARE ENGINEER
description:
Orani is an AI-powered virtual receptionist built for solo and micro service

settings UX

production

management doesn't intimidate you

queries

Vonage, Bandwidth)

- Are comfortable reading and writing TwiML or similar call flow markup

- Can SSH into an EC2 instance, debug a running service, and deploy a fix

without hand-holding

what's blocked



---

Nice to Have



- Experience with VAPI or other AI voice platforms

- Prior work on a consumer mobile app with real users



---

What We're Not Looking For



Someone who needs a fully specc'd ticket for every task. This codebase is

real, the bugs are real, and the users are real. You should be able to look at

a problem, understand the system, and figure out the fix.



---

Stack: Flutter · Dart · Python · Django · Twilio · VAPI · TwiML · AWS EC2





To Apply



Send a short note about something you've built — mobile, backend, or both —

and why this kind of product interests you. Links to work are more useful than

a resume.

title: META ADS MEDIA BUYER/ STRATEGIST
description:
Do not apply unless you have maximum confidence in your ability to deliver results. We will ask for proof.



Ensure you read the whole description. 



Media Buyer — Meta Ads Specialist

Reports to: Head of Growth / Marketing Director

Full-time | Performance Marketing | Paid Social



About the role

We're looking for a results-driven, high-performance Media Buyer who lives and breathes Meta advertising. You've managed substantial budgets, know how to scale without blowing ROAS, and can back everything up with hard data. If you've turned paid social into a predictable growth engine, we want to talk.



At a glance



Minimum ROAS: 3.0+

Monthly spend managed: $10k+

Experience required: 2+ years Meta Ads

Track record: Proven ability to scale





Key responsibilities



Own end-to-end campaign management across Meta Ads Manager — from strategy and build to optimisation and reporting, across multiple accounts simultaneously.

Strategically scale ad spend — increasing budgets and expanding audiences while maintaining a minimum 3.0 ROAS, using proven budget-pacing and bid management techniques.

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers — building a clear testing log and acting on results with speed.

Brief and collaborate with the creative team to produce high-converting ad assets — you understand what makes a Meta ad stop the scroll and drive conversions, and you can communicate that clearly.

Monitor account health daily — diagnosing performance drops, frequency issues, audience fatigue, and delivery problems before they impact results.

Build and manage full-funnel campaign structures — prospecting (TOF), retargeting (MOF/BOF), and retention — with a clear understanding of how each layer interacts.

Set up and maintain accurate tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), custom events, and UTM parameters — ensuring data integrity across all campaigns.

Deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights — no vanity metrics, just ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and the story they tell.

Stay ahead of Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats — proactively adapting strategy before performance is affected.





What we require



Proven spend experience: you must have personally managed Meta ad accounts at $10k+ monthly spend. You'll be asked to provide account-level results, not agency-level attribution.

Demonstrated ROAS performance: a consistent track record of sustaining 3.0+ ROAS at scale. You must be able to show this with real data.

Deep Meta Ads Manager expertise: campaign objective selection, CBO vs ABO strategy, Advantage+ campaigns, broad vs interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and manual vs automated bidding.

Scaling methodology: you have a clear, repeatable process for scaling budgets — whether through horizontal expansion, budget multipliers, or audience diversification — without destabilising campaigns.

Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar attribution tools. You don't just read dashboards — you interrogate data to form hypotheses.

Tracking & measurement fluency: solid understanding of iOS 14+ attribution impact, CAPI implementation, and how to maintain reporting accuracy in a privacy-first landscape.

Creative instinct: you understand performance creative — hooks, UGC formats, video vs static — and can brief a team or give concrete, actionable feedback on ad assets.

Self-sufficient and accountable: you flag problems early, own outcomes, and don't wait for direction. You manage your accounts like they're your own business.





Nice to have



Experience running Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube alongside Meta as part of a blended paid strategy.

Experience in DTC / e-commerce environments where ROAS and blended MER are primary KPIs.

Shopify analytics experience and understanding of how paid social integrates with on-site conversion rate.

Experience managing multiple client accounts with varying spend levels, verticals, and objectives.

Meta Blueprint certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.





Interview process



Application review — Submit a brief summary of your highest-spend account, the ROAS achieved, and how you scaled it.

Intro call (30 min) — Walk us through your experience, biggest wins, and how you think about scaling.

Paid task / case study — A short paid exercise: audit a real or sample account and present your findings and action plan.

Final interview — Deep dive with the hiring manager. We'll go through your case study and align on strategy.





Important note

We take results seriously. During the process, you'll be expected to share real performance data (anonymised if needed) that validates your experience. Candidates who cannot demonstrate their ROAS track record with data will not progress.
