We are looking for a highly creative and tech-savvy **Social Media & Web Content Creator** who is an expert at using **AI tools to create high-quality digital content quickly and professionally**.



This is NOT just a social media posting position.



We need someone who can take an idea, brand, product, or business and transform it into professional digital content — including **landing pages, websites, social media graphics, videos, advertisements, and marketing campaigns.**



## Responsibilities



You will help create and manage:



* Social media posts and graphics

* Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn content

* Short-form videos, Reels, Shorts, and TikToks

* Video editing, captions, transitions, effects, and B-roll

* AI-generated images and creative assets

* Landing pages and high-converting sales pages

* Website sections and simple websites

* Lead-generation pages

* Digital advertisements and promotional graphics

* Marketing funnels and calls-to-action

* Brand-consistent social media content

* Content calendars and campaign ideas

* Thumbnails, banners, flyers, and promotional materials

* AI-assisted copywriting and content creation



## AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You should be very comfortable working with modern AI tools.



Experience with tools such as the following is highly preferred:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Google AI Studio

* Midjourney

* Nano Banana / Gemini image generation

* Canva

* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Photoshop

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* Runway

* Veo

* Sora

* Other AI image/video generation tools



You do NOT need to know every tool listed above, but you should understand how to use AI to dramatically improve the speed and quality of your work.



## Web & Landing Page Skills



You should understand how to create modern, beautiful, mobile-responsive landing pages.



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* HTML / CSS

* JavaScript

* WordPress

* Webflow

* Framer

* Lovable

* Replit

* AI Studio

* Other AI website builders



You should understand basic **conversion-focused design**, including:



* Strong hero sections

* Clear calls-to-action

* Lead capture forms

* Testimonials

* Social proof

* Mobile responsiveness

* Visual hierarchy

* Landing-page psychology



We don't just want pages that look beautiful.



**We want pages that convert visitors into leads and customers.**



## Who We Are Looking For



You are someone who:



* Has an excellent eye for design

* Understands social media trends

* Can edit professional short-form video

* Understands branding

* Can create content without needing constant instructions

* Knows how to research competitors and develop creative ideas

* Learns new AI tools quickly

* Is comfortable experimenting with new technology

* Can take a rough idea and turn it into polished content

* Pays attention to small details

* Works quickly without sacrificing quality



Creativity and problem-solving ability are extremely important for this position.



## IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply waits for detailed instructions for every task.



We want someone who can be given an objective such as:



**“We need a landing page and social campaign for this business.”**



…and independently research, create concepts, use AI tools, design the page, develop graphics, edit videos, and help bring the campaign to life.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your portfolio.

3. Examples of landing pages or websites you have created.

4. Examples of social media graphics you have created.

5. Examples of videos or Reels you have edited.

6. A list of the AI tools you currently use.

7. Tell us which AI tool you use the most and why.

8. Tell us what you would improve about one website or social media account you have previously worked on.



**Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term and become an important part of our creative and digital marketing team.

title: Experienced Senior Project Manager (Amazon FBA | Full-Time)
description:
# Join a Fast-Growing E-Commerce Brand Based in Singapore



We’re a fast-growing Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand looking for a highly capable **Amazon E-Commerce Director / Senior Project Manager** to help us scale.



This is not a coordinator role.



We’re looking for someone who can **see the big picture while being highly meticulous with the details**. You should be comfortable managing people, analysing data, improving systems, identifying problems early, and taking ownership of execution.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll oversee a team of around 6 people across listings, design, and operations.



You’ll manage product launches and Amazon projects from planning through execution.



You’ll review sales, profitability, advertising, inventory, conversion, rankings, and other key data to identify opportunities and risks.



You’ll coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, inspection agents, inventory planning, production, and shipping.



You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.



You’ll maintain accurate dashboards and reporting so management always has a clear view of the business.



You’ll identify bottlenecks and recurring problems, then improve the systems behind them rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues.



## We Want Someone Data-Driven



You should naturally ask questions like:



Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see a problem, raise it.



If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.



## Tools You’ll Use



Amazon Seller Central

Google Sheets and Docs

Notion

Helium 10

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For



At least **5 years of relevant experience**, ideally in Amazon FBA or e-commerce operations.



Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours



Monday to Friday

12 PM to 10 PM Singapore time

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and why you’re a good fit.



Clear details of your Amazon FBA experience.



Your most recent role and what you personally owned.



Examples or references to Amazon brands or projects you have worked on.



Examples of teams or projects you have managed.



A short video introduction if possible.



Please also tell us about **one Amazon or e-commerce problem you identified through data, what you discovered, and what action you took.**



## Important



Only candidates with genuine Amazon FBA experience will be considered.



This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

title: Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor
description:
Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor



We’re looking for a driven Junior/Mid-Level Podcast Editor to join our team and grow with us long-term.



Your main responsibility will be editing and polishing podcast content, but this role is designed to become much more than that. You’ll work alongside experienced editors and creatives, learning advanced editing, VFX, storytelling, and YouTube-specific techniques as you develop.



We’re looking for someone who already has a solid foundation, not necessarily an expert, but understands the fundamentals of text animation, rotoscoping or rotobrushing, audio balancing, sound effects, color grading, and motion graphics.



We’ll provide guidance and mentorship, but the end goal is for you to become a highly capable, self-sufficient editor who can take ownership of projects and produce world-class content without needing constant direction.



If you have the fundamentals and are serious about becoming exceptional at your craft, this role is for you.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Edit, clean, and polish one podcast episode per week into a professional, high-quality final video.



Maintain extremely high quality control. No syncing issues, unnecessary dead air, spelling mistakes, or sloppy frames.



Create animated intros, text overlays, motion graphics, and SFX that improve the viewing experience.



Balance dialogue, music, and sound effects to create clean and professional audio.



Perform fundamental color correction and grading.



Learn directly from senior editors and creatives to improve your VFX, storytelling, pacing, and YouTube editing skills.



Take increasing ownership of the podcast editing pipeline until you can manage the production process independently.



What We’re Looking For



Fundamental to intermediate proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.



Strong understanding of audio mixing, balancing, and basic sound design.



Fundamental color grading skills.



Experience with basic motion graphics, text animation, rotobrushing, and visual effects.



Extreme attention to detail. A typo, bad cut, awkward pause, or frame being out of sync should bother you.



A portfolio that demonstrates clean editing, audio work, and basic motion graphics.



A genuine student-of-the-game mentality. You actively study great editors and want to improve quickly.



Ability to take feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously raise the quality of your work.



Strong communication and organizational skills.



Ability to consistently deliver one polished edit per week without sacrificing quality.



Self-motivated and capable of gradually working with less supervision.



Our Standard

Experience working with high-performing creators or entrepreneurs.



Understanding of how YouTube editing differs from traditional video editing.



Ability to build efficient editing workflows and production systems.



Experience managing projects through 
, ClickUp, or similar tools.



Compensation



$100 to $150 per video, depending on your skill level, quality, and editing speed.



Please include your preferred rate range when applying.



Who This Role Is For



We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want editing tasks. We want someone who wants to become an exceptional editor.

title: Social Media Scheduler (Posting, Full Time, US Hours)
description:
Ascend Content is a short form video agency based in the US. We run content for founders and creators from strategy and scripts through editing and posting, and the whole operation lives in our own web app, Ascend OS.



We are hiring one full time Social Media Scheduler to run the posting desk for every client we serve. You make sure the work the team made goes live, on the right account, at the right time, every day.



Your day, in order:



You start in the morning in Ascend OS. You open the posting desk and the content calendar and see what is due today. You schedule those posts to YouTube Shorts, X, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Captions and hashtags are written for you, and you post them exactly as delivered, character for character, no rewrites. If an asset is missing or wrong, you flag it to the editor or strategist right away. Later you check back and confirm the posts went live, and you fix anything that failed. At the end of the day you submit the posting report in Ascend OS: what went out, what is still sitting in the queue, what blocked you, and what you plan to handle tomorrow.



A good fit is reliable in a boring, valuable way. You keep the same hours daily, you work on Eastern time without being reminded, and you catch small things, like a post set for 4:00 PM instead of 4:00 AM. You are comfortable in a web app and in native schedulers, and your written English is clear enough for a daily report and a flag someone can act on.



What this role is not: no video editing, no strategy or content ideas, no writing captions. Creative decisions stay with the strategists and editors. If you take pride in a clean, on time board, this is a very good seat.



Pay is $700 to $1,000 USD per month depending on experience. Full time and fully remote. Hours run on Eastern time, on and off across 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET, with some weekend posting.



Hiring process: a short application here, a small paid test task (schedule three sample posts in a sandbox), then a video call.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the word SCHEDULED on the first line of your application, then answer three questions:



1. Your timezone, and which hours you can commit inside 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET.

2. One tool you have used to schedule posts before.

3. It is 4:55 PM ET and the video for a post going out tonight is missing. In one sentence, what do you do?



Applications that do not start with SCHEDULED are not read.

title: Onboarding and Listing Manager (Short Term Rental)
description:
We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We operate under a co-hosting model — property owners retain their listings, reviews, and branding while we handle operations, guest experience, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028.



Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end.



Role Mission

Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea
mber succeeds or struggles.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 90 Days)

• Time from signed contract to first live booking: under 21 days on 90%+ of new properties.

• Owner satisfaction score on onboarding: 9/10 or higher measured via post-onboarding survey.

• Zero listing errors at go-live — amenities, photos, pricing, house rules, and descriptions verified and correct.

• Pricing strategy configured correctly on day one — dynamic pricing tools set up with appropriate base rates, seasonality, and event-based adjustments.

• Full operational handoff document complete for every new property before go-live — cleaning, maintenance, guest experience, and pricing teams receive complete information.

• Onboarding SOP maintained and improved quarterly based on what worked and what broke.



Core Responsibilities



Owner-Facing Onboarding

• Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline.

• Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor.

• Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond.

• Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management.

Listing Build & Optimization

• Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model).

• Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion.

• Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging.

• Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate.



Pricing Setup

• Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves.

• Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules.

• Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable.

• Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in.

Operational Handoff

• Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks.

• Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives.

• Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days.

Process Improvement

• Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed.

• Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality.

• Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks.



Required Experience & Skills

• 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent.

• Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or 
 listings from scratch.

• Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez).

• Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond).

• Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls.

• Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details.

• Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes.



Preferred (Not Required)

• Prior experience in hospitality, property management, or client onboarding.

• Experience with Breezeway, Slack, Salesmsg, and GetClearing.

• Design eye for listing photos and descriptions.

• SEO or listing optimization experience on major OTA platforms.



Non-Negotiable Traits

• Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip.

• Owner-facing confidence. You can hold a call with a $500K+ property owner and make them feel informed, respected, and confident in Divergent.

• Process thinker. You build systems, not one-offs.

• Ownership mindset. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this."

• Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. You stay steady, clear, and solution-oriented.



What We Offer

• Competitive hourly rate for a qualified STR operator.

• One of the most strategically important roles in the company — onboarding directly drives growth and retention.

• Quarterly performance reviews with bonus opportunities.

• Direct access to the owner (Nick) for strategic decisions.

• Long-term role with growth potential as we scale to 200+ properties.

• Professional development, coaching, and 1:1 time with leadership.



Hiring Process

1. Resume and written application — confirm STR onboarding experience.

2. 2-minute Loom video introduction — walk us through a property you onboarded from scratch.

3. First interview (30 minutes) with Divergent leadership.

4. Paid trial project ($75–100): Draft a 5-step onboarding plan with timelines for a sample property, write the owner welcome
, and identify the top 3 risks for this specific property.

5. Reference checks — minimum 2 written references with specific questions.

6. Owner call with Nick — cultural fit and final decision.

7. 30-day paid trial starts.

title: Short-Term Rental Property Operations Manager - Full-Time US Hours
description:
HOURS PER WEEK

40



MONTHLY SALARY

USD $1,300-$2,000 per month



JOB OVERVIEW



ABOUT DIVERGENT ESTATES



Divergent Estates is a growing U.S.-based short-term rental management company. We help property owners operate professional, guest-ready vacation rentals across multiple U.S. markets.



We are hiring a long-term, full-time Short-Term Rental Property Operations Manager. Internally, we call this role a Pod Manager.



This is not a general virtual assistant or customer-service-only position. It is an ownership role for someone who can build the operating team around a small group of properties and then manage those properties from A to Z.



HOW THE ROLE STARTS



You will be assigned a small number of target properties before they are fully transitioned to you.



For each property, you will:



- Validate and organize the property information

- Build the primary and backup cleaning team

- Build the local maintenance and specialty-vendor bench

- Document contacts, procedures and escalation paths in Notion

- Configure HostBuddy AI so it can answer routine guest questions

- Review the PriceLabs setup and learn the approved pricing guardrails

- Identify open problems and create a stabilization plan

- Pass a property-readiness review



Once the property passes the readiness review, you will formally accept responsibility for it. Properties will transfer to you one at a time, so you will own the team and operating system you helped build.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Cleaner scheduling, performance, inspections and backup coverage

- Maintenance intake, troubleshooting, vendor dispatch and completion follow-through

- Daytime guest issues that HostBuddy AI cannot resolve

- Proactive owner communication and documented decisions

- Property supplies, recurring services and operational readiness

- Accurate property and vendor information in Notion

- PriceLabs execution within approved company guardrails

- Open tasks from the first report through verified completion

- Operational onboarding for additional properties assigned to your pod



PriceLabs ownership includes monitoring calendar health, minimum-stay rules, orphan gaps, local events and approved overrides. Major pricing strategy and changes outside the approved guardrails require company approval until you complete our internal certification.



✅ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confidence making phone calls to U.S.-based cleaners, handymen and vendors

- Experience in short-term rentals, property management, hospitality operations or a comparable operations role

- Strong problem-solving and prioritization under time pressure

- Ability to troubleshoot maintenance issues before sending a vendor

- Clear documentation and disciplined follow-through

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a professional call setup

- Ability to work full time without overlapping full-time employment

- Comfort accepting responsibility for results, not only completing assigned tasks



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



- Hostaway or another property management system

- Breezeway or another cleaning and maintenance platform

- PriceLabs or another revenue-management tool

- Notion, Slack or remote documentation systems

- HostBuddy or another AI guest-messaging system

- Cleaner, handyman or vendor sourcing in unfamiliar markets

- Owner-facing communication



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This is a full-time remote position with primary coverage during U.S. Central Time business hours. There will be a scheduled weekend rotation. Overnight on-call coverage is handled separately.



The exact working schedule will be confirmed before an offer.



Base compensation is USD $1,300-$2,000 per month from day one, including the initial build-to-own ramp. Placement within the range depends on demonstrated experience, spoken communication, maintenance judgment and ability to operate independently.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term role with the opportunity to manage a larger portfolio and grow in compensation as performance and responsibility increase.



HOW TO APPLY



Start the first line of your application with the word OWNERSHIP. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. Your resume or a summary of your relevant work history

2. A 60-90 second audio or video introduction explaining your relevant experience

3. Your answers to the five questions below



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. How many properties, units or active clients have you directly supported? What work did you personally own?



2. Describe a time you sourced a cleaner or maintenance vendor in a market where you had no existing contacts. What did you do and what was the result?



3. A cleaner cancels three hours before a same-day guest check-in. Walk us through your first 15 minutes and your next steps.



4. Describe a maintenance problem you helped troubleshoot before sending a vendor. What questions did you ask and how did you d
 what to do?



5. Which property-management, pricing or operations systems have you used? Explain what you personally managed inside those systems.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid, role-specific exercise before the final interview.

3D Rendering / Architectural Visualization Specialist

Remote | Full-Time | Residential Construction

Schondorf Enterprises is seeking a talented 3D Rendering and Architectural Visualization Specialist to create high-quality, photorealistic interior and exterior renderings for residential construction projects for a Design Build firm in California. 



You will receive all the CAD / Sketchup files and support, along with references of the materials so that you can focus on creating the best renderings without losing much time. 



This position is a retainer position, where you’re expected to be on hand to complete the projects as they come in. You will get paid ₱8,700 every week (Friday) via Wise. Some weeks will have more work and others will have less work. We can evaluate as we progress. 



Responsibilities

Produce photorealistic interior and exterior architectural renderings

Translate architectural drawings, 3D models, and design concepts into compelling visuals

Apply realistic lighting, materials, textures, landscaping, and environmental details

Incorporate feedback and complete revisions accurately

Manage multiple assignments while meeting agreed-upon deadlines

Communicate clearly and collaborate remotely with our team



Qualifications

Strong architectural rendering and visualization skills

Portfolio demonstrating high-quality residential interior and exterior work

Proficiency with software such as SketchUp, Enscape, Lumion, V-Ray, D5 Render, 3ds Max, Corona, or comparable tools

Ability to read and work from architectural drawings and design documentation

Excellent eye for composition, lighting, materials, textures, and realistic detail

Reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working independently

Experience with U.S. residential construction projects is preferred



Position Details

Remote

Part-time to start

Potential to grow into a full-time position

Workload and schedule to be discussed based on availability and project needs

Compensation based on experience, portfolio quality, and scope of work



How to Apply

Please
 
 with the subject line:

3D Visualization Specialist Application – [Your Name]

Resume or CV

Rendering portfolio or portfolio link

Software proficiency

Expected hourly or project-based rate

Weekly availability

Current location and time zone

Earliest available start date

title: Cybersecurity / IT Specialist – Browsers, VPNs, Networking & Online Security
description:

We are looking for a highly technical Cybersecurity / IT Specialist who is extremely knowledgeable about how modern internet browsers, networks, devices, and online security systems work.



This is NOT a traditional corporate cybersecurity position. We are specifically interested in someone who enjoys experimenting, troubleshooting, researching, and solving unusual technical problems.



Experience or strong knowledge in any of the following is valuable:



* Browser security and privacy

* Chrome, Firefox and other browser environments

* Browser isolation and separate browser profiles

* VPNs, proxies and IP addresses

* Networking and DNS

* Device and browser fingerprinting

* Geolocation and location/privacy technologies

* Cookies, sessions and browser storage

* Virtual machines and remote environments

* Windows, Android and Google ecosystems

* Cybersecurity and online privacy

* Automation and AI tools

title: Notion & Systems Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a growing short-term rental business operating across Airbnb arbitrage and co-hosting property management. We're looking for a Systems Operations and Automation Specialist to become the backbone of our backend operations, someone who takes ownership of our systems the way an equity partner would, not someone who waits to be told what to do next.



This is not a task-list VA role. We already have a partially built Notion workspace (built from a professional template with full instructional video modules) that needs to be completed, customized, and brought to a fully operational level across all four of our departments: Finance, Marketing, Co-Hosting, and Arbitrage. From there, the role evolves into long-term ownership of our operational systems and automations.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just execute, but who notices what's missing, fixes it, documents it, and teaches the team how to use it, without needing to be asked.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Phase 1: Foundation:

Complete and customize our existing Notion template across all four departments (Finance, Marketing, Co-Hosting, Arbitrage) to reflect our specific business operations

Identify and build any additional systems or structures needed to make each department fully operational

Create clear SOPs and step-by-step guides so the team can actually use what you build, not just leave it for us to figure out



Phase 2: Automation and AI-Assisted Workflows:

Build automations connecting Notion, Calendly, Tallyforms, Google Workspace, and 
 using Make

Set up and refine Claude-based workflows to support marketing (content ideation, data/pattern analysis) and sales (CRM management, follow-up sequences, sales page support)

Troubleshoot and improve the backend systems as real usage reveals gaps



Phase 3: Continuous Improvement (Ongoing):

Continuously look for smarter ways to organize, automate, and optimize our systems

Stay current on new Notion, Make, and Claude capabilities relevant to our business

Proactively bring ideas to the table, not just fixes, but genuine improvements



Team Workflow Support:

Help the team operate more efficiently day to day via 
 (reminder automations, workflow improvements)

Collaborate directly with team members to improve department-specific processes based on their real needs



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required Skills

- Advanced Notion skills (databases, relations, rollups, formulas, templates, dashboards)

- Experience building automations with Make (or similar tools like Zapier)

- Comfort using Calendly, Tallyforms (or similar form tools), and Google Workspace

- Experience using Claude or ChatGPT for real workflow/process building (not just casual use)

- Strong speaking and written communication skills in English



Nice to Have

- Experience in short-term rental, real estate, or property management operations

- 
 automation/bot setup experience

- Basic understanding of business finance structure (you won't manage finances, but you'll build the systems that track them)



Who You Are

- You notice when something is incomplete or could be better, and you fix it without being asked

- You ask clarifying questions when something is unclear, because you actually want to understand the "why," not just complete a task

- You document what you build so others can use it, not just so it exists

- You hold yourself accountable and stay organized without needing constant check-ins

- You see this as an opportunity to build something real, not just a job to complete



Who This Is Not For

- Someone who needs a detailed to-do list to stay productive

- Someone who does the bare minimum and stops once the literal task is technically done

- Someone applying to every listing without reading the details



HOW TO APPLY



All applications must be submitted through the link below.







Applications that do not include a working portfolio link (a Notion system you've built) will not be considered.



We're looking to fill this role with someone we can build a long-term working relationship with. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Email Deliverability & Domain Reputation Specialist (GHL)
description:
We send 50,000+ marketing/transactional
s per week and several thousand SMS messages through GoHighLevel (LC
 + LC Phone). Volume is increasing. We recently had a deliverability i
 that cost us thousands of dollars when webinar registrants stopped receiving event reminders.



We need a true expert — not a generalist
 marketer, not a funnel builder, not a "VA who has done some
." A specialist who can keep our sending infrastructure healthy, run domain warmups properly, monitor reputation daily, and catch problems *before* they cost us money.



---



What You'll Own



- Daily monitoring of domain reputation across Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and blacklist services

- SPF / DKIM / DMARC configuration and ongoing alignment management

- Setting up and warming dedicated sending subdomains

- A2P 10DLC SMS campaign registration and ongoing compliance

- Weekly bounce, complaint, and engagement reports with specific recommendations

- Diagnosing and fixing deliverability i
 quickly

- Running warmup tools (Mailreach / Warmup Inbox / Instantly / Smartlead) for new domains



---



Required Experience



- Hands-on management of high-volume sending (20K+/week or more) on GoHighLevel, Mailgun, SendGrid, or similar

- Proven track record running domain warmup ramps from cold to production volume

- Working knowledge of DNS — you can read and write SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records without help

- Experience using Google Postmaster Tools and Microsoft SNDS in your daily workflow

- A2P 10DLC campaign registration experience (through Twilio or TCR)

- At least one example of a deliverability problem you diagnosed and recovered from



---



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY — generic applications will be rejected)



In your application, answer all five of these questions. Skip any of them and we won't review your application.



1. Explain the difference between SPF *pass* and SPF *alignment*, and why DMARC cares about alignment.

2. Walk me through a 30-day warmup ramp for a brand-new subdomain that needs to handle 50,000
s per week. Tell me Day 1 volumes, Day 30 volumes, who you send to during warmup, and what you monitor daily.

3. What's your exact process for checking sender reputation across Gmail and Outlook? Name the tools and the metrics you track.

4. Have you registered an A2P 10DLC campaign before? Walk me through the brand and campaign registration process. If you haven't done one, say so honestly — but know that this is required for the role.

5. Tell me about a specific time a domain you managed got blocked, blacklisted, or sent to spam. What was the root cause, how did you diagnose it, and what specific steps did you take to recover? "I checked the settings" is not an answer.

---

We pay fairly, we move quickly, and we promote people who deliver. We do not waste time on applicants who exaggerate experience — your work-sample test will expose that fast, so please apply only if you have the actual skill.

title: QuickBooks Bookkeeper | Financial Organisation
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and experienced **Bookkeeper / Finance Manager** who is highly familiar with **QuickBooks** and can take responsibility for keeping my business finances organized and up to date.



Responsibilities



* Manage and maintain bookkeeping in QuickBooks

* Categorize transactions correctly

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other accounts

* Keep income and expenses properly organized

* Maintain accurate financial records

* Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Identify unusual expenses, discrepancies, or missing transactions

* Keep the books clean and ready for my accountant/tax advisor

* Help create a clear financial structure for the business



Weekly Financial Reporting



Every week, I want a simple and easy-to-understand financial report covering:



* Revenue

* Expenses

* Profit / Loss

* Cash flow

* Current cash position

* Outstanding payments / liabilities

* Major expenses from the week

* Comparison to previous weeks

* Any financial issues or things I should be aware of



The goal is for me to be able to quickly understand **where the business stands financially every week without having to go through QuickBooks myself.



Requirements



* Strong experience with **QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online**

* Previous bookkeeping experience for businesses

* Strong understanding of P&L, cash flow, balance sheets, and general accounting

* Very organized and detail-oriented

* Able to communicate financial information in simple language

* Reliable with weekly reporting and deadlines

* Comfortable proactively pointing out problems or opportunities instead of only entering transactions



When Applying



Please include:



1. Your experience with QuickBooks

2. What types of businesses you have handled bookkeeping for

3. An example of what your weekly financial report would include

4. How you normally organize a company's bookkeeping and financial reporting

5. Your availability and expected monthly rate



I’m looking for someone long-term who can eventually become the person I rely on to keep the financial side of the business organized, accurate, and easy to understand.

title: Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
JOB OPENING: OPERATIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT



Company: Skyride Auto Services

Employment Type: Part-Time (20–25 hours per week)

Location: Remote (Must be available during U.S. business hours)



About Skyride Auto Services



Skyride Auto Services is a rapidly growing car rental company based in Columbus, Ohio, specializing in affordable and reliable vehicle rentals for rideshare and delivery drivers. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service, flexible rental options, and a seamless rental experience.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a motivated, professional, and customer-focused Operations Virtual Assistant to become an important part of our team.



Position Overview



As our Operations Virtual Assistant, you will play a key role in the day-to-day operations of our business. You will be one of the first points of contact for prospective and existing customers, communicating with customers over the phone, answering questions, following up on rental inquiries, scheduling reservations, and guiding customers through the rental process.



In addition to customer communication, you will support administrative, operational, and customer service functions that help keep our business running efficiently.



This is a part-time remote position (20–25 hours per week). Applicants must be available to work during U.S. business hours.



Key Responsibilities



* Customer Communication: Speak with prospective and existing customers by phone, answer questions, explain our rental program, and assist customers throughout the rental process.

* Customer Follow-Up: Promptly follow up with rental inquiries, missed calls, and existing customers to provide exceptional customer service.

* CRM Management: Manage and update customer information in GoHighLevel (or similar CRM), ensuring accurate records and seamless customer follow-ups.

* Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and resolve issues promptly via phone, text,
, and social media.

* Reservation Management: Manage reservations, confirm bookings, and coordinate vehicle pick-up and return appointments.

* Fleet Management: Track vehicle availability, coordinate maintenance schedules, and assist with fleet logistics to ensure vehicles are rental-ready.

* Billing & Payments: Process rental payments, generate invoices, and maintain accurate payment and financial records.

* Administrative Support: Perform data entry, organize documents, maintain rental agreements, and manage all rental records.

* Scheduling: Coordinate customer appointments, vehicle maintenance, and other business-related schedules.

* Social Media Management: Assist with social media posts, manage online listings, and respond to customer reviews and messages.

* Customer Updates: Regularly communicate reservation updates, payment reminders, rental offers, and important company notices to customers.

* Perform other administrative and operational duties as assigned to support the growth of the business.



Qualifications



* Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Customer Support Representative, Administrative Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role preferred.

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone throughout the day.

* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.

* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work independently.

* Experience using CRM software (GoHighLevel preferred).

* Proficient with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and common communication tools.

* Experience in the car rental, automotive, transportation, or rideshare industry is a plus, but not required.



What We Offer



* 100% Remote Position

* Part-Time Employment (20–25 hours per week)

* Competitive Pay

* Opportunity for growth within a fast-growing company

* Supportive and collaborative work environment

* Long-term career opportunity with room for advancement



How to Apply



Please
 the following to 



* Your resume

* A short video introduction (2–3 minutes)

* A brief cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit for this position.



Subject Line: Operations Virtual Assistant Application



We look forward to welcoming a motivated team member who is ready to grow with Skyride Auto Services!

description:
I'm Leon — I run a Meta media buying operation for UK home-improvement trades (roofing, tree surgery, landscaping, driveways). I manage around 20 accounts myself and I'm scaling. Hiring two people to take the delivery load off me.



WHAT YOU'D DO



- Build new client campaigns end to end —
 page, ad account, campaign, ad sets, creative, GoHighLevel

- Maintain live accounts daily — spot problems, act on them, keep cost per lead on target

- Follow my documented process. Everything is written down. You execute, you don't invent.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- Real experience running Meta ads for real clients. Not "I did a course." If you've never built a lead generation campaign end to end and defended the numbers to a paying client, this isn't right for you yet.

- Someone who reads instructions and follows them precisely. When something's unclear, you ask — not guess.

- Strong written English. No client-facing work, so accent doesn't matter — writing does.

- Wants a long-term seat, not a quick gig.



TERMS



- £200/month base (roughly $250 USD)

- £50-£100/month per account you fully own — build and maintain

- Ramp to around 15 accounts within 3 months — about £1,200/month ($1,500 USD) at that point. The book is scaling, so more from there.

- First month is training and observation at base only. If you arrive plug-and-play we skip the observation and you take accounts straight away.

- Around 4 hours a day overlapping UK daytime for the first four weeks while I train you. After that, work whenever suits you.

- Long-term. I'm not looking to hire again in 6 months.



TO APPLY



Fill out this form — about 4 minutes:



https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdo3lVTo5a7JmKARxl2-XUlOTZm1wfUMOkc9Mbpja32vEwWOA/viewform?usp=dialog



No CV needed — everything I need is on the form. I read every application.



When you fill in the form, put a dash and the word "pug" after your name in the first question to prove you read the full job description.

title: Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role
description:
# Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role



## READ THIS FIRST — BOTH PAID TEST VIDEOS ARE REQUIRED



**You must complete BOTH paid test videos to be considered for this position.**



There are **two required test videos**, and both must be completed. If you complete only one, your application will not be considered.



Both test videos are paid whether or not you are ultimately hired.



The tests are designed to evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Editing speed

* English comprehension

* Attention to detail

* Ability to source your own assets

* Understanding of American culture and internet references

* Knowledge of current trends

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to make strong editing decisions independently



If you are not willing to complete both test videos, please do not apply.



I review completed tests as they arrive and interview strong applicants quickly. There is no fixed closing date. Once I find the right person, the position will be filled.



---



## POSITION



**Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor**



TikTok / Reels / Shorts



---



## TYPE / SALARY



**Full Time**



**Starting salary: $2,200 USD/month**



Paid through Wise.



This is the starting position, not the ceiling.



There are several opportunities to move into **higher-paying and higher-responsibility positions** for people who consistently perform well.



Raises and advancement are based on:



* Editing quality

* Speed

* Output

* Reliability

* Communication

* Understanding of the content

* Ability to operate independently

* Trend awareness

* Ability to contribute ideas

* Ability to take ownership of larger parts of the content operation

* Leadership and management ability



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the business over the long term.



---



## SCHEDULE AND WORKLOAD



This position requires **6–7 days of availability per week**.



Normal working days are approximately **10 hours per day**.



You must also be comfortable working **late-night hours in the Philippines and regularly working until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when needed**.



This is necessary because the role requires significant overlap with U.S. working hours and because content needs to move quickly.



Some days will be substantially heavier than others.



During major content pushes, launches, high-performing trends, urgent projects, or other time-sensitive periods, you must be comfortable occasionally working **14–16 hour days** when necessary.



This is a **high-volume operation**.



You must be capable of completing **up to approximately 30–40 short-form videos in a day** when the format and workload require it.



Not every day will require maximum output, and different video formats take different amounts of time, but you must have the speed, organization, and stamina necessary to handle extremely high-volume days without sacrificing quality.



If you are looking for:



* A strict 40-hour-per-week position

* A Monday–Friday-only schedule

* A fixed daytime schedule in the Philippines

* A role where you completely disconnect after your scheduled shift



this is probably **not the right position for you**.



---



## JOB DESCRIPTION



I run TikTok pages that consistently reach millions of views and produce content at significant scale.



I am looking for an editor who can eventually operate as much more than someone who simply follows instructions.



You should understand what makes short-form content perform, recognize trends quickly, understand American internet culture, and develop strong instincts for what belongs on screen without needing every decision explained to you.



Success in this role comes down to five things above everything else:



**Editing quality.

Speed.

English comprehension.

Cultural awareness.

Responsiveness.**



All five are extremely important.



---



## THE WORK



You will primarily edit short-form vertical content including:



* Talking-head videos

* Voiceover/b-roll videos

* Product-focused content

* Commentary videos

* Trend-driven videos

* TikTok Shop content

* Other fast-moving vertical formats



Typical responsibilities include:



* Cutting dead space so videos stay fast-paced

* Stitching the strongest takes together seamlessly

* Identifying which takes should be used without needing every selection made for you

* Adding image overlays that support what is being said

* Adding screenshots, comments, posts, website images, memes, and other visual assets

* Using zooms, crops, reframes, and movement to keep the frame dynamic

* Building b-roll sequences around voiceovers

* Matching visuals to individual lines of a script

* Finding your own visual assets when they are not provided

* Knowing when an image, meme, celebrity photo, reaction, screenshot, or cultural reference makes sense

* Reviewing your own exports before submission

* Fixing obvious issues before sending work

* Learning the brands, people, products, and content styles we work with

* Following trends and identifying opportunities before they become outdated



---



## AMERICAN CULTURE, TRENDS, AND ENGLISH



This is one of the most important requirements of the entire position.



You must have **excellent English comprehension**.



You need to understand not only the literal meaning of a sentence, but also:



* Humor

* Sarcasm

* Tone

* Slang

* References

* Internet terminology

* American social-media culture

* Celebrity culture

* Influencer culture

* College culture

* Reality television references

* TikTok trends

* Memes

* Viral moments

* Current online conversations



If a script references an American celebrity, viral TikTok moment, reality show, meme, brand, influencer controversy, cultural moment, or popular internet reference, I cannot stop production every time to explain what it means.



You should either already understand it or be capable of researching it immediately.



You must also be **extremely knowledgeable about current TikTok trends and American internet culture**.



Following trends is part of the job.



I want someone who naturally spends enough time online to understand:



* What people are currently talking about

* Which sounds are trending

* Which creators are relevant

* Which memes are circulating

* Which stories are going viral

* What visual styles are performing

* Why certain content is gaining attention



You should not need me to introduce you to every trend.



---



## SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



You must be highly self-sufficient.



I will provide direction, scripts, footage, and context depending on the video, but I should not need to create a complete asset folder for every edit.



You should be capable of:



* Reading or listening to a script and determining what visual belongs with each line

* Finding high-quality images of celebrities, influencers, products, brands, locations, and other subjects

* Choosing visually strong images rather than simply using the first search result

* Finding TikTok comments, Reddit posts, social posts, screenshots, articles, and other supporting material

* Navigating brand websites and identifying which areas are worth showing

* Taking clean screenshots

* Finding relevant b-roll

* Understanding which assets strengthen the story

* Knowing when an asset is unnecessary

* Placing every asset at the correct moment in the video



You should be able to receive a script, voiceover, or raw video and independently determine what additional material is needed to make the finished edit engaging.



---



## COMMUNICATION AND RESPONSIVENESS



Communication speed is **extremely important**.



Short-form content moves quickly, and delays in communication can delay an entire content schedule.



During your scheduled working hours, I expect responses to messages within approximately **30 minutes**.



Outside of your scheduled working hours, while you are awake, I generally expect responses within approximately **one hour** when something comes up.



You are not expected to wake up during normal sleeping hours specifically to respond.



However, **once you wake up, you should check your messages immediately and respond to anything outstanding**.



You should remain highly responsive throughout the day.



This position is best suited for someone who naturally checks communications frequently and does not disappear for many hours without notice.



If something prevents you from responding or working normally, communicate that immediately.



---



## WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



I am looking for someone who is:



### Extremely detail-oriented



You notice when:



* A clip is held too long

* An overlay is slightly misplaced

* Subtitles are wrong

* A crop looks awkward

* An image does not match the sentence

* A video feels slower than it should

* Something simply does not look polished



### Fast



Quality matters, but you must also be able to produce content at significant volume.



### Reliable



If you say something will be completed, I should not have to repeatedly ask about it.



### Highly responsive



You communicate quickly and clearly.



### Self-sufficient



You solve normal editing and sourcing problems independently rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



### Extremely familiar with TikTok



You understand:



* Trends

* Hooks

* Pacing

* Memes

* Creators

* Sounds

* Visual styles

* Viral formats

* What currently performs



### Familiar with American culture



You understand the references being made in the content without needing constant explanation.



### Strong in English



You understand speech naturally enough to catch nuance, humor, sarcasm, tone, and context.



### Comfortable with direct feedback



I give direct feedback.



You must be able to apply it quickly and avoid repeatedly making the same mistake.



### Hard-working



Some days are normal.



Some days are extremely busy.



You need to be comfortable with both.



### Interested in advancement



I want someone who eventually wants more responsibility and significantly higher compensation.



### Long-term focused



I am hiring someone I can build with over years, not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.



---



## EXCLUSIVITY



This is a full-time position and should be treated as your primary professional commitment.



Because of the workload and responsiveness required, you should **not be simultaneously managing multiple full-time clients, operating an editing agency, or subcontracting your assigned work to other editors**.



I want the person hired to personally do the work and become deeply familiar with the pages.



In exchange, you receive:



* Stable monthly compensation

* Consistent workload

* Direct access to the person running the pages

* Performance-based advancement

* Opportunities for substantially higher-paying positions

* Increased responsibility as you prove yourself

* The ability to grow as the business grows



---



## REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Proven short-form editing experience

* Experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content

* CapCut or another editing program you can work extremely quickly in

* Strong English comprehension

* Strong understanding of American internet and pop culture

* Strong knowledge of current TikTok trends

* Ability to independently source images, screenshots, b-roll, comments, posts, and other assets

* Strong visual judgment

* Reliable high-speed internet

* A computer capable of handling high-volume editing

* Availability **6–7 days per week**

* Ability to work approximately **10 hours per normal working day**

* Ability and willingness to **regularly work until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when required**

* Ability to occasionally work **14–16 hour days**

* Ability to complete **up to approximately 30–40 videos in a high-volume day**, depending on video complexity

* Ability to respond within approximately **30 minutes during working hours**

* Ability to respond within approximately **one hour outside working hours while awake**

* Ability to check and respond to outstanding communications promptly after waking up

* Ability to receive payment through Wise

* Ability to take direct feedback and apply it immediately

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision

* Long-term availability



---



## PAY AND GROWTH



**Starting compensation: $2,200 USD/month.**



This is **not the ceiling**.



There are multiple opportunities to advance into substantially higher-paying positions for someone who consistently performs.



I care much more about what you become capable of than how long you have worked here.



Someone who demonstrates exceptional:



* Editing ability

* Speed

* Reliability

* Judgment

* Leadership

* Trend awareness

* Communication

* Understanding of the pages

* Ability to manage responsibility



can move into larger roles within the operation.



The goal is to develop someone who eventually understands the content operation extremely well and contributes far beyond basic editing.



---



## HOW TO APPLY



**Subject line:**



**EDITOR — [number of the example video you think is hardest to edit]**



Example:



**EDITOR — 2**



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be reviewed.



Please include:



### 1. Portfolio



Send links to **2–3 short-form videos you personally edited**.



For each video, explain exactly what you handled.



If you edited only part of a video, say so.



Accuracy matters more than trying to make your experience sound larger than it was.



### 2. Editing Evaluation



In your own words and **without AI assistance**, watch example #3 and write **3–5 sentences** explaining:



* One editing choice you think worked particularly well

* One thing you would have approached differently

* Why



There is no predetermined correct answer.



I want to understand how you evaluate content.



### 3. Background



Tell me:



* What editing software you use

* How long you have used it

* Your internet speed

* Your typical available hours in Philippine time

* Whether you currently have another job

* Whether you currently have freelance clients

* Why you are looking to leave your current work

* How familiar you are with American TikTok and internet culture

* Whether you are comfortable regularly working until **3:00 AM PH time or later**

* Whether you are comfortable working **6–7 days per week**

* Whether you are comfortable with occasional **14–16 hour workdays**



### 4. Trend Question



Answer:



**What American TikTok trend, meme, creator, celebrity story, or internet topic have you seen repeatedly in the last seven days? Explain it briefly and tell me why you think it became popular.**



Do not research an answer specifically for this application.



I want to see whether you naturally follow the same internet culture the content depends on.



---



## PAID TEST — YOU MUST COMPLETE BOTH VIDEOS



To move forward in the hiring process, you must complete **BOTH paid test videos**.



Completing only one test video will **not** qualify you for consideration.



You will receive source material including:



* Reference videos

* Raw footage

* Voiceovers

* Editing instructions



The test folders will intentionally **not contain every visual asset required**.



Part of the test is determining what additional visuals are needed, finding those assets yourself, and placing them correctly.



The two tests are designed to evaluate different aspects of the position.



Together, they will be used to determine whether you move forward to an interview.



The tests evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Editing speed

* Attention to detail

* English comprehension

* Understanding of context

* American cultural awareness

* Trend knowledge

* Visual judgment

* Asset sourcing

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to make good decisions without being told exactly what to do



**Both test videos are paid regardless of whether you are ultimately hired.**



A strong performance on both test videos will be followed by a short interview and then a potential start date.

title: Creative Quality Lead for AI Video Agency (Full Time, Long Term)
description:
We make AI generated video ads for international brands, mostly US telehealth and health.



I am looking for someone to own the creative from both ends. You write the briefs that go to the team, and you are the last set of eyes before the work ships.



What you would actually do



The front end. A client tells me they want 10 UGC and 10 animated ads testing new angles. I give you the direction, the product and the reference material. You turn that into actual briefs for the team. What the scene is, who the character is, what the script says, what the reference looks like, what the specs are. Clear enough that a generator or an editor can pick it up and run without asking questions.



You will use AI heavily to do this. Brainstorming scene ideas, drafting scripts, and building generation prompts with ChatGPT or Claude is part of the daily workflow, not a shortcut. I will show you how we do it.



Writing a brief that produces the right video first time is a skill. Most people write briefs that are too vague and then spend three rounds fixing the output.



The back end. Every video that comes off my team passes through you before it reaches me or a client. Your job is to know whether it holds up. Did the character change between scene one and scene three. Is the lighting inconsistent. Is the product name mispronounced. Does the pacing kill the hook. Does it actually match the brief you wrote.



When it does not, you send it back with specific notes.



The middle. Assigning the work to the right person, chasing whatever assets we are missing, and holding the deadlines across several clients at once.



You will not be generating or editing yourself. You own the brief and the standard.



Who this is for

-You can write a brief that someone else can execute without coming back with questions

-You are comfortable using AI as a working tool, brainstorming scenes and drafting prompts with it rather than just asking it for answers

-You have a real eye. You can watch an ad and say exactly what is wrong with it, not just that it feels off

-You have worked in video, creative, or content and you care about the craft

-Small errors bother you. Inconsistent captions, a face that changes, a cut in the wrong place

-You are organised enough to track work across several projects

-You are comfortable telling someone their work needs redoing, and doing it in a way that does not make them defensive

-You want to grow into creative direction rather than stay an individual contributor



You do not need to have been a manager before. If you can write a good brief and judge good work, I will teach you the coordination side.



Who this is not for

-You want to be the one making the videos

-You avoid difficult conversations

-You are looking for a stepping stone into your own agency

-You would treat this as one of several clients



What you get

-Direct training from me on our standards, our process, and how performance creative actually works

-Real ownership of the creative from brief to delivery

-A business growing quickly with international clients, and a role that grows with it

-A path into creative direction as the team scales

-Paid on time, every time



Hours



Full time, 40 hours a week, Philippine business hours. Fully remote.



Requirements

-Background in video, creative, content, or production

-Strong written English. Most of this job is writing clear briefs and clear notes

-Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude as part of your daily process

-Comfortable learning project tools like Trello, Notion, ClickUp

-Reliable internet and a computer that handles video review

-Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement



Experience with AI video tools is a plus but not required. I will teach you the stack.



How to apply



Read this properly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word ANCHOR so I know you read the whole post.

2. Here is a rough direction, the kind of thing I would hand you: a telehealth brand sells a weight loss medication online for ninety nine dollars a month. They want short vertical ads aimed at women in their forties who have tried and failed at dieting. 3. Write me one brief for one video, exactly as you would hand it to someone on the team.

3. Send me a link to a video ad you think is badly made and tell me exactly what is wrong with it. Be specific about that ad, not ads in general.

4. How do you use AI in your work day to day?

5. Your background, when you can start, and your salary expectations.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test on real work, paid whether or not I hire you.

title: TIER A CREATIVE DESIGNER
description:
READ



TIER A CREATIVE DESIGNER



IF YOU’RE JUST A “NORMAL” DESIGNER, DO NOT APPLY.



We are not looking for someone who can simply “do graphic design.”



We’re looking for a Tier A multidisciplinary creative — someone with exceptional visual taste, original ideas and the technical ability to bring those ideas to life across design, AI, packaging, video, digital and brand.



You should be able to take a rough idea and turn it into something significantly better than what was originally briefed.



If you need every reference, layout, concept and direction given to you before you can start, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Develop original creative concepts and campaign directions for SUPR

- Create high-level graphics for social media, advertising, website and e-commerce

- Design product packaging, labels, pouches, boxes, retail displays and other physical brand assets

- Understand print-ready artwork, dimensions, bleed, dielines and production requirements

- Create product mockups and launch visuals

- Use AI creative tools to accelerate and elevate concepts, visuals and production

- Generate and manipulate AI imagery while maintaining brand consistency

- Edit short-form videos, Reels, TikToks and advertisements

- Create engaging cuts, transitions, typography, subtitles, sound design and basic motion graphics

- Turn raw footage into polished, brand-ready content

- Create performance ad creatives for Meta, TikTok and other platforms

- Develop website banners, product pages, marketplace creatives and campaign assets

- Build strong typography, layouts and visual systems

- Adapt campaigns across multiple formats without simply resizing the same artwork

- Work across static, motion, video, AI and physical packaging

- Proactively bring new ideas and creative directions to the team

- Do more than what is given — identify what can be improved and make it better



YOU SHOULD BE STRONG IN



Graphic Design

Photoshop, Illustrator and other professional creative tools.



AI Creative

Comfortable using modern AI image/video tools as part of a professional creative workflow. We want someone who knows how to use AI creatively — not someone who depends on it to compensate for weak design fundamentals.



Packaging Design

Able to work from concept through to production-ready packaging artwork.



Video Editing

Able to turn raw footage into strong Reels, TikToks, product videos, campaign edits and paid advertisements.



Branding & Art Direction

Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, colour, photography and brand consistency.



Digital & E-Commerce

Understand that creative for Meta, TikTok, Shopify and marketplaces needs to do more than simply look good — it needs to communicate and convert.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



Do not apply if:



- Your portfolio mainly consists of basic Canva graphics

- You rely heavily on templates

- You only know static graphic design

- You cannot edit videos

- You have no understanding of packaging or production artwork

- You use AI without strong underlying design skills

- You simply copy references

- You need detailed instructions for every creative decision

- You only complete exactly what is assigned

- You cannot conceptualise independently

- You are looking for a position to learn the basics



WE ARE STRICTLY LOOKING FOR TIER A TALENT.



Your qualifications matter less than what you can actually create.



We want someone who can think, design, edit, experiment, execute and elevate.



TO APPLY



Send us:



1. Your portfolio

2. CV / relevant experience

3. Expected salary

4. Availability / notice period

5. Your 3 strongest creative projects

6. Examples of video editing

7. Examples of packaging / product design

8. Examples of AI-assisted creative work, if available



No strong portfolio = application will not be considered.



We are not hiring someone to simply fill a creative position.



We are looking for someone who can help define what SUPR looks like.

title: Short-Form Video Editor, DJ Sets & Podcasts for Social Media (Could grow to full time))
description:
Full Scope Entertainment is an Austin-based DJ and event production company. We're looking for an editor to turn raw multi-camera footage from DJ sets and podcast interviews into short, eye-catching social media clips. No full-length edit needed, just the highlight clips.



For each piece of source footage (one DJ set recording or one podcast interview), you'll produce:

- 10 separate short-form clips, 15 to 30 seconds each

- Clips built around a strong hook that hold attention on their own, not just a random trimmed section

- Text overlays, captions, or simple graphics added where they make a clip more eye-catching or easier to follow

- Delivered in formats ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and our website



Requirements:

- A portfolio with examples specifically from live music, concerts, DJ sets, or podcasts turned into short-form social clips. General reel-editing samples with no live music or podcast experience won't be considered

- A strong sense for what makes a clip stop the scroll, hook selection, pacing, captions

- Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut, plus caption tools like Descript

- Comfortable with async feedback via WhatsApp and Trello

- Reliable turnaround, 48 to 72 hours per batch of clips

- Use TIMEPROOF to clock hours



Bonus, not required: experience scheduling and posting content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube (Later, Metricool, Buffer, or similar). If you can take this on too, mention it in your application; it could grow into a bigger role and mean you don't need to hire a separate social media person.



To apply, send 2 to 3 links to your best work specifically from DJ sets, concerts, or podcast content cut into short-form clips. We'll follow up with a small paid test edit before any long-term commitment.



Here's a reference video (Please don't apply if you don't think you could do something like this.  BONUS if you have done something like this before)

The Art Department Manager will oversee the daily operations of our Philippines-based art team. This person will be responsible for recruiting qualified graphic artists, assigning projects, reviewing artwork, managing deadlines, maintaining production standards, and communicating with our U.S.-based management team.

* Protect confidential company, customer, and design information

* Previous experience managing an art, graphic design, or production team

* Proven experience recruiting, interviewing, and hiring employees

* Strong leadership and team-management skills

* Ability to motivate employees and hold team members accountable

* Excellent organizational and project-management skills

* Strong attention to detail and quality control

* Ability to manage several projects and deadlines at the same time

DESIGN AND PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE

* Adobe Illustrator
