title: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
description:
About the Role



I’m looking for a highly experienced Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist to join my content creation business on a full-time, long-term basis.



I am a medical doctor and content creator producing educational, skincare, beauty and lifestyle content across TikTok and Instagram.



This is not a junior editing role. I am looking for someone with significant professional short-form editing experience, exceptional creative judgement and a strong understanding of what drives performance across TikTok, Instagram and the wider social media landscape.



The role combines senior-level short-form video editing, creative direction, content ideation and social media trend awareness.



A core part of this position will be proactively helping to develop and evolve the editing style of the content. The successful candidate should not simply replicate the existing editing style. They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging.



The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas.



This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential.



Core Responsibilities



Senior Short-Form Editing & Creative Direction



* Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance

* Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution

* Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision

* Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly

* Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques

* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail

* Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval



Evolving the Editing Style



A major responsibility of this role is to actively help shape and evolve the creative editing direction of the content.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram

* Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging

* Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced

* Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure

* Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience

* Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time

* Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand



The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next.



Content Ideation & Trend Spotting



This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned

* Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content

* Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content

* Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content

* Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts

* Proactively share useful creative references and examples

* Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand

* Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed



For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea.



Picture Carousels & Canva



* Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva

* Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content

* Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments

* Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity

* Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required

* Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram

* Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels



Paid Brand Partnerships



* Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style

* Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements

* Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform

* Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial

* Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently



Seniority & Experience



This is explicitly a senior-level position.



Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work.



The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation.



Applicants should be able to demonstrate:



* Significant professional short-form video editing experience

* A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content

* Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance

* Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong proficiency in Canva

* Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram

* A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling

* Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour

* The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity

* Strong independent creative judgement

* The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate

* The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction

* Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail

* Clear and proactive communication

* Strong organisation and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment



What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor is someone who:



* Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work

* Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement

* Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly

* Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content

* Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing

* Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance

* Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour

* Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance

* Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves

* Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked

* Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content

* Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions

* Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective

* Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Is highly dependable and consistent

* Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines

* Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged

* Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily



This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential.



Turnaround Expectations



This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times.



First Draft Turnaround



Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video.



For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours.



The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours.



Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently.



Revisions



* Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback

* More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible

* The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests

* Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds



Flexibility & Availability



This is a full-time role with flexible working hours.



There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule.

SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & GROWTH PARTNER



Part-Time | Remote | USD $300 Per Month



ABOUT MAISON MNANDI AFRICA



Maison Mnandi Africa is an African lifestyle brand celebrating craftsmanship, heritage and contemporary living through thoughtfully curated fashion, accessories and home décor.



We are building a storytelling-led e-commerce brand that brings authentic African artistry into modern lifestyles through elevated imagery, meaningful narratives and a refined editorial aesthetic.



Our products are chosen for their beauty, character and cultural significance. Every visual should invite discovery, every caption should add meaning and every brand touchpoint should feel considered, respectful and beautifully executed.



Website: 





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking a creative, organised and commercially aware Social Media Content & Growth Coordinator to help shape Maison Mnandi Africa’s digital presence and grow an engaged community around the brand.



Working closely with the Founder, you will transform our existing library of professional photographs, videos and product stories into thoughtful, consistent and compelling social media content. You will play an important role in ensuring that our online presence reflects the quality, warmth and cultural richness of the Maison Mnandi Africa experience.



Instagram will be our primary platform. Selected Instagram content will be adapted for
 and 
 rather than created separately for these platforms. Where appropriate, suitable ready-made Instagram videos may also be repurposed for TikTok.



This is not simply a scheduling or posting position. We are looking for someone who can understand a brand’s visual language, make discerning content choices, write with warmth and clarity, and use performance insights to strengthen future content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Develop and manage a monthly social media content calendar.

* Select, organise and prepare content from our existing professional asset library.

* Create and deliver an average of 16 fully prepared Instagram feed content pieces per month, featuring an agreed mix of Reels, carousels and static posts.

* Create approximately two Instagram Story updates per week using existing brand photos, videos and other approved content. Each update will usually include 2–4 separate Story slides, such as product details, behind-the-scenes images, reminders, polls or links.

* Write engaging, brand-aligned captions and calls to action.

* Complete light graphic design in Canva and video editing in CapCut, or use comparable creative tools.

* Adapt and 
 selected Instagram content for
 and 
 rather than creating separate original content for these platforms.

* Repurpose suitable ready-made Instagram video content for TikTok where appropriate.

* Submit the monthly content calendar and completed content for the Founder’s review and approval before scheduling and publication.

* Schedule and publish approved content according to the agreed content calendar.

* Conduct relevant keyword, hashtag and trend research.

* Track key performance indicators and prepare a concise monthly report.

* Recommend practical content and performance improvements based on insights from the monthly report.



Organic growth is a shared objective. You will contribute through consistent execution, thoughtful content and informed recommendations, but you will not be solely responsible for guaranteeing follower growth, website traffic or sales.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Previous social media experience with an e-commerce, fashion, lifestyle, home décor, cultural or premium consumer brand.

* Strong visual judgement and an instinct for clean, refined and editorial content.

* Excellent English copywriting, storytelling and proofreading skills.

* Experience creating Reels, carousels, Stories and short-form video content.

* Proficiency with Canva and CapCut, or comparable creative tools.

* Working knowledge of current content formats and best practices across Instagram,
, Pinterest and TikTok.

* A practical understanding of organic growth, content strategy and social media analytics.

* Strong organisation, communication and attention to detail.

* A genuine appreciation for African craftsmanship, culture and storytelling.

* The ability to work independently, take initiative, follow direction and meet deadlines.

* A thoughtful, collaborative approach and the confidence to bring forward creative ideas.



Experience with a premium, design-led or culturally focused brand will be highly valued.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



* Position: Part-Time Freelance Contractor

* Location: Remote

* Working Structure: Flexible and deliverables-based

* Remuneration: USD $300 per month as a flat-rate retainer

* Initial Contract: Three months, subject to performance review



Content may be created in batches and scheduled in advance. Daily availability is not required, provided all agreed deliverables, deadlines, publishing schedules and quality standards are met.



The successful candidate will be evaluated according to the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the agreed work rather than fixed daily working hours.



There is potential for a longer-term engagement and remuneration review based on performance, reliability, business requirements and brand growth.



Please note that paid advertising, influencer management, professional photography, advanced video production, community management, customer service, Shopify administration and
 marketing are not included in this role.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short paid practical trial using supplied Maison Mnandi Africa content.



The trial will require the candidate to:



* Create one completed 5–7-slide Instagram carousel using the supplied brand assets.

* Write one accompanying caption with a clear call to action.



A fixed payment of USD $20 will be provided upon submission of the complete trial task, regardless of whether the candidate is invited to the final interview or selected for the position.



Candidates who demonstrate strong visual judgement, storytelling ability, brand understanding and practical thinking will be invited to a final online interview with the Founder.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the first line of your application with the word CULTURE in capital letters.



Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why Maison Mnandi Africa and this role interest you.

2. Links to social media accounts you currently manage or have previously managed.

3. Examples of Reels, carousels or other content you personally created.

4. Specific organic growth or engagement results you have achieved.

5. The tools you use for content creation, scheduling and analytics.

6. One content idea you would test for Maison Mnandi Africa.

7. Confirmation that you accept the core terms: part-time, deliverables-based, USD $300 per month and an initial three-month contract.



We are looking for someone who can bring both creative sensitivity and dependable execution to a growing African lifestyle brand. Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Freight Billing Specialist
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. Built on disciplined systems, structured SOPs, and financial accuracy, we operate with a strong focus on execution, accountability, and real-time visibility.



As we scale nationally, we are hiring a Freight Billing Specialist to serve as a critical financial control point across both load validation and carrier invoicing workflows, ensuring loads and invoices are accurate, fully documented, dispute-free, and ready for Finance and factoring.



Role Overview

You will act as the final gatekeeper before loads and invoices move to Finance and factoring, ensuring every load is fully validated first, then properly invoiced and submitted. This role requires flexibility, ownership, and the ability to operate across both functions without compromising accuracy or SOP compliance.



What You’ll Be Doing



Load Validation

• Validate all loads before final status, ensuring correct Completed, Cancelled, or TONU determination.

• Review and correct load statuses in TMS and ensure all required documentation is complete, accurate, and properly uploaded.

• Verify financial accuracy, including rates, FSC, accessorials, fines, TONU logic, and other load-related charges.

• Investigate carrier disputes, maintain clear audit-ready notes, and resolve discrepancies before escalation.

• Ensure only fully documented, financially accurate, and dispute-free loads proceed to Finance, invoicing, and factoring submission.



Carrier Invoicing

• Upload and process carrier invoices accurately in TMS, verifying amounts against rate confirmations and approved charges.

• Ensure all required supporting documents are complete, including POD, BOL, detention, lumper, and other applicable receipts.

• Request and follow up on missing or incomplete invoices and coordinate with carriers or factoring companies as needed.

• Identify invoice discrepancies, resolve Held, Rejected, and Denied items, and escalate issues with proper documentation.

• Maintain audit-ready invoice records and ensure only complete, validated invoices proceed to Finance or factoring submission.



Fuel Surcharge Updates & Fines and Detention Processing

• Update and validate daily Fuel Surcharge (FSC) values, reconcile Customer vs. TMS revenue, and adjust Line Haul Fees as needed.

• Review and process carrier fines, including compliance validation, FourKites/POD checks, LoadStop updates, revised Rate Confirmations, and disputes within required timelines.

• Review and process detention requests by validating documentation and timestamps, calculating approved charges, and rejecting unsupported requests.



What Success Looks Like

• Maintain 95%+ of loads reaching Finance without rework.

• Ensure zero missing documentation and zero financial discrepancies at the billing stage.

• Maintain fully audit ready loads and invoices with minimal documentation or validation related disputes.

• Process loads and invoices within the required 24–48 hour timeframe.

• Ensure all factoring submissions meet documentation and compliance standards.



Required Skills & Qualifications

• Experience in U.S. freight brokerage, load auditing, QA, carrier billing, or transportation operations, with knowledge of dry van and refrigerated freight.

• Strong understanding of TONU, rate confirmations, accessorials, FSC, and freight documentation requirements.

• Knowledge of TONU, rate confirmations, accessorials, and FSC

• Familiarity with TMS, ELD, tracking systems, and factoring processes; factoring experience is preferred.

• Strong attention to financial accuracy, documentation, audit readiness, and SOP compliance with the ability to manage shifting priorities.

• Strong written and verbal English communication, minimum 45–50 WPM typing speed, and comfort working in a structured, accountability-driven environment.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Wednesday - Sunday 8 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor setup with a $75 monthly insurance stipend after 30 days of eligibility.

• Structured, KPI, and SOP-driven systems with a defined training path.

• High impact role supporting financial control, revenue protection, and billing accuracy.

You do not need to figure out our ad strategy yourself. We will train you on exactly how we want our ads built, how we research winning concepts, how we structure creatives, and what makes an ad a winner for our brand.



You'll get clear examples, proven frameworks, feedback, and direction from our team.



You'll be doing:



* Building our video ad engine: recreating proven winning concepts from competitors, indirect competitors, TikTok Shop, and other sources natively — using new B-roll, AI avatars, cloned voices, product integrations, and fresh executions so every ad feels original.



* Reworking competitor videos specifically for our product: we will regularly give you competitor creatives that are already proven winners. Your job is to rebuild/adapt those videos so they become completely relevant to our brand — including replacing the competitor's product with our own product, changing product-in-hand shots, creating new AI B-roll where needed, and making sure the script, visuals, and overall video feel like the ad was originally created for our product.



* Seamlessly integrating our product into existing concepts and scenes, including realistic product swaps, packaging replacements, product-in-hand shots, and AI-generated scenes where our product looks natural and believable.



* Turning our winning long-form static scripts into videos, including talking-head ads, VSL-style creatives, movie-credit ads, and other direct-response formats.



* Fast iteration: producing a high volume of new video creatives and variations every week.



* Following our proven creative frameworks and turning our direction into polished, high-quality finished ads.



* Using AI to create realistic custom B-roll instead of relying purely on existing stock footage.



Must-haves — NON-NEGOTIABLE:



* You must have previously worked with MRR / subscription brands doing at least $250K+ per month in revenue.



* Proven experience editing performance ads for established DTC / e-commerce brands.



* A strong portfolio showing paid-social creatives you've made for real brands.



* Strong hands-on experience with HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, and Veo3.



* Able to create your own AI B-roll, including realistic product-in-hand swaps and product integrations.



* Able to take competitor creatives and rebuild them specifically around a different product/brand, while keeping the winning concept intact.



* Able to recreate winning concepts from scratch without simply copying or re-cutting existing footage.



* Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, pacing, hooks, retention, captions, B-roll, and native social creative.



* Able to take direction, follow creative frameworks, and implement feedback quickly.



* Fast communication and reliable turnaround.



* You must be extremely fast without sacrificing quality. We expect roughly 2–3 finished video ads per hour, depending on the complexity of the creative.



We're looking for someone who is already very skilled at what they do. If you're still learning AI video editing, direct-response editing, or need extensive guidance to produce high-quality creatives, this role is not the right fit.



Nice to have:



* Experience specifically with supplements, health, wellness, or other direct-response products.



* Experience working with brands spending aggressively on Meta.



* Experience producing creatives at high volume for scaling brands.



Pay:



Starts at $10/hr, with a performance bonus from month 2 based on winning ads.



There is significant room to grow with us if you're consistently fast, reliable, and producing winning creatives.

title: Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO)
description:
Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO)

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



JAR Consulting Group is a U.S.-based digital marketing and technology company looking for an exceptionally strong SEO and AI Search/GEO professional.



Please read this entire posting before applying.



This is NOT an entry-level or intermediate SEO position.



We are not looking for someone who has simply used SEO tools, optimized WordPress pages, generated AI content, or recently started calling themselves a GEO expert.



We are looking for someone who can prove that their work has produced measurable organic search results and who has a sophisticated understanding of how search is evolving across Google, AI search engines, and large language models.



Our goal for our clients is straightforward:



Get them found, mentioned, cited, and recommended wherever their prospective customers search—including Google and AI platforms.



What Makes This Position Different

JAR is building a new SEO/GEO operating model combining:



Human expertise + first-party expert content + AI agents + automation + measurable search data.



We produce substantial original content through client interviews, podcasts, livestreams, videos, transcripts, articles, FAQs, and short-form content.



We are also building AI agents to automate repetitive SEO/GEO activities, analyze websites and data, identify opportunities, assist with content optimization, monitor performance, and eventually execute approved website changes.



We are not hiring someone to spend 40 hours per week performing repetitive SEO tasks that software and AI can perform.



We need someone capable of thinking, analyzing, developing strategy, validating AI output, identifying opportunities, and determining what needs to happen next.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

Please DO NOT APPLY  unless you meet these requirements.



1. Minimum 3 Years of Advanced SEO Experience

You must have at least three years of hands-on responsibility for SEO campaigns where you personally influenced measurable results.



We are not interested solely in years of employment.



We want evidence of results.



2. You Must Provide Proof of Your Work

Your application must include at least three examples of websites or campaigns you personally worked on.



For each example, explain:



Website/business

Your specific responsibilities

Starting situation

Strategy you implemented

Time period

Organic traffic improvement

Ranking/visibility improvement

Leads/conversions when available

Tools/data used to measure the results

What YOU personally did versus what the rest of the team did

Provide supporting evidence wherever possible, including screenshots from Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, or other legitimate platforms.



If confidentiality prevents you from showing any evidence whatsoever of previous results, you must find a way to prove you have the experience. If you cannot prove real results, do not apply.  **We respect legitimate client confidentiality. You may redact names or sensitive information where necessary. However, you must be able to demonstrate that you have actually produced measurable results.



3. Advanced Ahrefs Experience

You should be highly proficient with Ahrefs, including:



Site Explorer

Site Audit

Rank Tracker

Keywords Explorer

Competitive analysis

Content gaps

Backlink analysis

Organic competitor research

Identifying actionable opportunities from the data

Simply having used Ahrefs does not qualify.



4. Strong Technical SEO Knowledge

You must understand and be able to work in:



Crawling and indexing

Google Search Console

Canonicals

Robots.txt

XML sitemaps

Redirects

404s

Internal linking architecture

Site structure

Core Web Vitals

Duplicate/thin content

Structured data/schema

Entity relationships

Local SEO fundamentals

You should be capable of diagnosing a technical problem and clearly explaining what a developer needs to fix.



5. Strong Local SEO Experience

Many JAR clients are established local and regional businesses.



You must understand:



Google Business Profiles

Local organic search

Local Pack/Maps visibility

Location/service-area strategy

Reviews and reputation signals

Citations/listings

Local competitive analysis

BrightLocal or comparable platforms



6. REAL GEO / AI SEARCH Experience

This is extremely important.



We are not looking for someone who watched several GEO videos, read some articles, or asked ChatGPT how GEO works.



We want someone actively working on AI search visibility.



Experience with platforms such as Scrunch, Profound, Peec AI, Otterly, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or comparable AI visibility platforms is strongly preferred.



You should understand concepts including:



AI mentions

AI citations

AI recommendations

Prompt tracking

AI share of voice

Citation/source analysis

Entity authority

Topic authority

Brand/entity signals

Content extraction and answerability

How traditional SEO intersects with AI discovery

How to determine WHY one business is being cited/recommended while another is not

You must be able to discuss strategies you have actually implemented, not simply explain GEO theory.



TECHNICAL & AUTOMATION CAPABILITY

You do not need to be a software developer.



However, our ideal candidate is technically comfortable.



Strong candidates will have experience with some combination of:



APIs

Webhooks

JSON

JSON-LD

HTML/CSS

Basic JavaScript

WordPress

GoHighLevel

Zapier

Make

n8n

AI APIs

LLM workflows

AI agents

Automated reporting/data pipelines

Python or other programming experience is a significant plus but is not required.



We have dedicated web development and AI automation resources. Your job is not necessarily to build everything yourself.



Your job is to be sophisticated enough to work alongside technical resources and help determine what should be built.



AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You must already be using AI professionally.



We expect familiarity with platforms such as:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

You should understand how to use AI for research, analysis, content optimization, data interpretation, workflow improvement, and quality assurance.



We are specifically interested in candidates who think:



"How can we automate this?"



rather than:



"This is how I've always done SEO."



At the same time, we do NOT want someone blindly trusting AI output.



You must know how to validate it.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO AT JAR

Your role would increasingly focus on strategy, analysis, QA, and opportunity identification, while our automation systems handle more repetitive execution.



Responsibilities will include:



Analyze traditional SEO and AI-search performance

Determine why clients are winning or losing visibility

Analyze Ahrefs, Scrunch, BrightLocal, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and other data

Identify organic and AI-search opportunities

Conduct sophisticated competitive analysis

Develop keyword, topic, entity and prompt strategies

Analyze AI citations and sources

Determine why competitors are being recommended by AI

Identify content gaps

Recommend podcast/interview topics based on search opportunities

Review client transcripts and expert content for SEO/GEO opportunities

Determine which existing website pages should be strengthened

Develop internal-linking strategies

Recommend appropriate structured data

Monitor technical SEO health

QA AI-agent recommendations

Help improve SEO/GEO agents and automation workflows

Coordinate technical implementations

Work with content resources to turn client expertise into authoritative content

Help improve our internal SEO/GEO methodology as search continues evolving

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This is a full-time, long-term position with JAR Consulting Group.



Starting compensation: $10–$20 USD per hour, based on demonstrated experience, technical ability, and proven results. Eligible for pay raises at 6 months and 1 year after employment based on performance.



We are willing to pay toward the top of that range for someone who can demonstrate that they truly have the experience and capabilities described in this posting.



Benefits include:



Paid time off

Paid local Philippine holidays

Company year-end bonus eligibility

Weekly Pay

Full-time, stable employment

Long-term opportunity for advancement

Direct access to company leadership

Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals

Significant opportunity to learn and work with AI agents, automation, GEO, and emerging search technologies

We are building this position for the future. As your capabilities and responsibilities grow, there will be opportunities to grow with the company.



WHY WORK WITH JAR?

We understand that choosing the right company matters just as much as choosing the right employee.



JAR is a U.S.-based company, but we have worked successfully with talented professionals in the Philippines and South America for years. Our Filipino team members are a vital part of our company—not simply outsourced 'VA' workers completing tasks. Regardless of where you live in this world, if you are on the JAR Team, you are a full and equal team member. 



We want talented people who are looking for a place where they can contribute ideas, develop professionally, learn new technologies, and build something long-term.



We are investing heavily in AI, automation, SEO, GEO, website technology, content production, and our own internal systems. The person who joins us in this position will have an opportunity to help shape how those systems are built rather than simply being handed a checklist every day.



We also want candidates to have the opportunity to evaluate us.



For candidates who advance through our interview process, we will arrange an opportunity for you to speak directly with members of our existing Filipino team without company leadership on the call.



You can ask them about:



What it's actually like working at JAR

How our U.S. leadership works with the Philippine team

Company culture

Communication

Expectations

Workload

Growth opportunities

Anything else you want to know before d
 whether JAR is the right place for you

We want you to hear about the company directly from people in the Philippines who already work here.



APPLICATION TEST

We assume strong applicants know how to use AI.



Therefore, polished writing alone will not impress us.



We care about your thinking and your evidence.



Answer the following questions in your application:



Question 1 — Proven Results

Provide your three strongest SEO case studies.



Give us numbers.



Show us evidence.



Tell us exactly what you personally did.



Question 2 — GEO Proof

Describe a specific project where you attempted to increase a company's visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI results, Copilot, or another AI search experience.



What did you do?



What did you measure?



What changed?



If you have not actually done this yet, say so. Do not manufacture an answer.



Question 3 — GEO Strategy

A well-established roofing company ranks reasonably well on Google but is rarely mentioned when consumers ask AI:



"Who are the best roofing contractors in [City]?"



Walk us through exactly how you would investigate the problem and what you would do during the next 90 days.



Be specific.



Question 4 — AI Citation Analysis

A client's competitor is repeatedly recommended and cited by AI systems while our client is not.



How would you determine WHY?



What data and sources would you examine?



Question 5 — Automation

Name three SEO/GEO tasks you believe should be automated with AI agents and three tasks you believe should remain human-led.



Explain why.



Question 6 — Technical SEO

Give us the most difficult technical SEO problem you personally diagnosed.



What was happening?



How did you identify it?



How was it fixed?



What happened afterward?



Question 7 — Your Tools

Rate yourself 1–10 and state your years of hands-on experience with:



Ahrefs

Google Search Console

GA4

BrightLocal

Scrunch

WordPress

Schema/JSON-LD

ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

APIs/automation

Python/programming



Do not give yourself a 10 unless you can defend it in a technical interview.



REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS

Your application must include:



Resume/CV

LinkedIn profile, if available

Three SEO case studies with measurable results

Supporting screenshots/data

Answers to all seven questions above

Examples of websites you've personally worked on

Your expected hourly compensation in USD

Your preferred working hours in Philippine Time

IMPORTANT

Applications that do not include case studies and measurable proof of previous SEO results will not be considered.



Generic cover letters will not help you.



Copying this job description into ChatGPT and submitting a perfect AI-generated response will not help you.



We are going to ask you to demonstrate your knowledge live during the interview process.



EDUCATION

A bachelor's degree in marketing, computer science, information technology, communications, business, or a related field is preferred but not required.



Demonstrated ability and measurable results matter more to us than the name of your university.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please don't apply if:



Your SEO experience is primarily writing articles

You primarily install SEO plugins and follow checklists

You've never personally been responsible for measurable SEO results

You cannot provide evidence of previous results

You have no technical SEO knowledge

You have no understanding of AI search/GEO

You believe GEO simply means writing content with ChatGPT

You aren't comfortable analyzing data

You don't understand schema

You cannot communicate clearly in English

You need detailed instructions for every task

You are uncomfortable learning rapidly

You dislike automation because you believe it threatens traditional SEO work

WHO WE WANT

We're looking for the person who reads this job description and thinks:



"Finally. This is where SEO is actually going."



You should be analytical, technically curious, skeptical of easy answers, obsessed with measurable results, comfortable working with AI, and excited about helping build a new operating model rather than inheriting an old one.



We aren't looking to fill a chair.



We're looking for someone capable of helping us build the next generation of JAR's SEO and AI Search operation.

title: Client Intake Specialist & Case Manager - US Personal Injury Law Firm (Medical or PI Experience REQUIRED)
description:
*** PRIOR MEDICAL OR PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED ***

Applications without it will not be read. See "REQUIRED BACKGROUND" below.



US personal injury law firm hiring ONE full-time Client Intake Specialist & Case Manager. This is a long-term, career position - not a short project.



WHO WE ARE

Big Bubba Injury Law is a personal injury law firm in West Virginia, USA. We represent people who were hurt in car crashes. We do not charge our clients anything up front - we only get paid when we win. Our clients are ordinary working people, and many of them are scared, in pain, and have never spoken to a lawyer before.



===========================================

REQUIRED BACKGROUND - READ THIS FIRST

===========================================



You must have real, verifiable experience in ONE of the following. This is not negotiable and it is not a "nice to have."



MEDICAL:

- Nurse, nursing graduate, or medical assistant

- Medical records, medical billing, or medical coding

- Health insurance claims processing or utilization review

- Medical transcription or medical scribe work

- Medical VA work for a US clinic, hospital, or provider



OR PERSONAL INJURY / LEGAL:

- Intake, case management, or paralegal work for a US personal injury law firm

- Demand package preparation, medical records summarization, or lien resolution

- Auto insurance claims handling or bodily injury adjusting

- Legal VA work for a US plaintiff-side firm



You will be reading medical records every single day. You need to already know what an MRI report says, what a chiropractor's SOAP note looks like, what "MMI" means, and why a 30-day gap in treatment matters. We will train you on our systems and our law. We will not train you on medicine.



In your application, state exactly where you got this experience, how long, and what you handled. Vague claims will be rejected.



===========================================



THE ROLE

You are the voice of this firm. An AI answering service takes the first call and passes qualified callers to you. From that moment, you own the client.



Two jobs in one:



1. INTAKE AND CLOSING (the first hour of the case)

- Take the handoff from our answering service and call the injured person immediately

- Build trust fast, get the facts of the crash and their injuries, and confirm we can help

- CLOSE. Persuade them to hire us, send the e-signature link, and stay on them until it is signed. Most people call more than one law firm. The firm that answers with a real human who cares is the firm that gets hired. That is you.

- Follow up relentlessly on unsigned links - same day, next day, day three



2. CASE MANAGEMENT (the next 6-12 months)

- Be the client's single point of contact for the life of their case

- Weekly calls while they are actively treating; biweekly at every other stage. We do not let clients wonder what is happening.

- Collect, review, and organize medical records and bills as treatment progresses

- Track the client's treatment trajectory and flag gaps, pre-existing conditions, and missing providers

- Chase down records from doctors' offices, hospitals, and imaging centers

- Coordinate with insurance adjusters within the scope the attorney sets

- Keep every case file complete and current in our case management software

- Prepare the file for the attorney at each stage



You are not giving legal advice. The attorney makes every legal decision. You run the relationship and the file.



ALSO REQUIRED



- NEUTRAL, EASILY UNDERSTOOD AMERICAN ENGLISH ON THE PHONE. This is a hard requirement. Our clients are in rural West Virginia. Many are elderly, many are in pain, and many will hang up if they have to ask you to repeat yourself. You must be understood effortlessly on the first call. Excellent written English as well - you will be sending client
s and texts under our firm's name.

- Real experience persuading people on the phone. Sales, appointment setting, closing, retention, collections, or high-end customer service. Tell us specifically what you sold or closed and what your numbers were.

- Full-time availability on US Eastern Time, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM ET (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a night shift in the Philippines. Do not apply if you cannot commit to it long term.

- Reliable computer, noise-free work environment, headset, and backup internet AND backup power. Our clients cannot hear roosters, tricycles, or family in the background.

- Empathy that is real. You will talk to people on the worst week of their life. If you cannot sit with someone who is crying and still get the information we need, this is not your job.

- Organized to the point of being obsessive. You will be managing 30-60 open cases at once.



BONUS

- Both medical AND personal injury experience

- Experience with case management software (Filevine, Litify, Smart Advocate, Clio, CasePeer, or similar)

- Experience with US health insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or ERISA subrogation



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary paid twice monthly, on time, every time

- 13th month pay

- Paid US holidays after 90 days

- Performance bonus tied to signed clients after 90 days

- Direct daily work with the firm's owner-attorney. No layers, no bureaucracy.

- Genuine growth. You are our first hire. As we grow, you lead the team.

- Full training on our systems and our process



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step will be deleted unread)



1. Put the word CHARLESTON in the first line of your application. This is how we know you read the post.



2. State your medical or personal injury experience in specific detail: employer, dates, and exactly what you handled.



3. Record a 90-second audio or video clip (Loom, Google Drive, or Vocaroo link) in which you:

   a. Introduce yourself and say why you want this job

   b. Then role-play this: you are calling Mary, 62 years old, rear-ended three days ago, neck and lower back pain, has not seen a doctor yet, and she is nervous about hiring a lawyer because she thinks it costs money. Get her comfortable, get her to see a doctor, and get her to say yes to signing with us. Improvise. We are listening to your voice, your warmth, and your ability to close.



4. In writing, tell us:

   - Your experience persuading people by phone, with specific numbers

   - Your exact home internet speed and whether you have backup internet and backup power

   - Confirm in one sentence that you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time long term

   - Your expected monthly salary in USD



We read every application that follows these instructions. We hire one person and we intend to keep them for years.

title: Influencer Outreach VA - Dutch Food & Kitchen Creators (Instagram + Email, Pay Per Message)
description:
ABOUT US

 

We are No Layer Kitchen, a Dutch kitchenware brand. We make titanium cutting boards - a replacement for plastic and wooden boards that does not scratch into your food, does not soak up bacteria, and lasts a lifetime. Our customers are people in the Netherlands who cook almost every day and care about what ends up in their food.

 

We grow by getting our boards into the hands of real Dutch home cooks and food creators, not by shouting at strangers with ads. That is your job.

 

 

THE ROLE IN ONE LINE

 

Find the right Dutch food and kitchen creators on Instagram, send each one a short, genuinely personal Dutch message offering a free titanium cutting board, and keep a simple record of everyone you contacted.

 

Personal beats perfect. One real message to the right person is worth fifty copy-pasted ones. That is the whole philosophy of this job and it is exactly how we score your work.

 

 

IMPORTANT - ABOUT THE DUTCH LANGUAGE

 

You do NOT need to speak Dutch.

 

We give you a complete Dutch message system: a fixed message template, plus a library of ready-made Dutch opening lines sorted by situation (a recipe they posted, a dish, their kitchen, their kids, a holiday). Your job is to pick the right building block for that specific creator and fill in the real detail you saw on their account.

 

You will be trained on this in your first week. If you can follow a system carefully and pay attention to detail, you can do this job without a word of Dutch.

 

What you DO need is good written English, because that is how you and I will talk to each other every day.

 

 

WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO, EVERY DAY

 

1. FIND CREATORS

Search Instagram by Dutch hashtag and keyword. Starting terms we use: koken, recept, receptvandedag, foodbloggernl, kokenmetliefde, gezondkoken, mealprepnl, foodienl, keukeninspiratie, hollandsepot, avondeten, watetenwevandaag, bakkenmetliefde. Like and save relevant posts so the algorithm keeps feeding you the right accounts. We also give you access to a creator search tool.

 

2. CHECK EVERY ACCOUNT AGAINST THE CHECKLIST

Six points, below. If one fails, you skip the account and move on. No exceptions. This protects our account and your time.

 

3. SEND THE MESSAGE

Instagram DM using our Dutch system, about 2 minutes per message. If the creator has a business
 in their bio, you send the
 version instead - those get read more often and are worth more to us.

 

4. RUN THE FOLLOW-UPS

Up to 3 follow-ups per creator, spaced out, each one adding something new. Then you stop, politely. A closed door is better than a burnt bridge. We give you the exact follow-up messages.

 

5. LOG EVERYTHING

A simple sheet: 
 date contacted, channel (DM or
), follow-up stage, replied yes/no, outcome.

 

6. HAND OVER THE WARM ONES

As soon as someone replies with interest, you send them our Dutch brand PDF and pass the account to me so I can ship the board.

 

 

THE CHECKLIST - EVERY ACCOUNT MUST PASS ALL SIX

 

1. FOLLOWERS - between 1,000 and 50,000. Not below 1k, not above 50k.

 

2. LOCATION - based in the Netherlands and clearly posting to a Dutch audience. You can tell from Dutch captions, Dutch place names, and prices in euros. Belgium (Flemish) also counts.

 

3. ACTIVE STORIES - they have a story up right now, or they post stories regularly.

 

4. ACTIVE POSTS - they post almost daily. Their most recent post is no older than 2 to 3 days.

 

5. REAL ENGAGEMENT - a quick eye test, no maths needed. Likes and comments should look right for the follower count, and the comments should look like real people, not bots or single emojis.

 

6. THEY ACTUALLY COOK ON CAMERA - the account shows real cooking, real food prep, a real kitchen. They need to be able to show a cutting board in use. A food photography account that never shows the cooking does not pass.

 

 

THE KIND OF ACCOUNTS WE WANT

 

Go broad across all of these:

- Dutch recipe and home cooking accounts (our core)

- Meal prep and healthy eating accounts

- Dutch mum and family accounts where cooking is a real part of the content

- Kitchen and interior accounts where the kitchen is the focus

- BBQ, grilling and butchery accounts

- Bakers, if they also do savoury cooking

 

 

THE MESSAGE - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THE JOB

 

Creators get dozens of identical "hi, we love your content!" messages every week and ignore every single one. The only thing that works is proving you actually looked at their account.

 

Every message must open with one specific, real detail about them, their cooking, or their kitchen. That one line is the difference between a real message and a bot.

 

THE FOUR PARTS OF EVERY MESSAGE

1. A unique, specific opening line about their account. Always. Never skip it.

2. Who we are - one warm sentence.

3. The offer - a free titanium cutting board, no obligation to post.

4. A soft, low-pressure question to reply.

 

GOOD OPENINGS - specific, clearly real

- "Die ovenschotel met prei die je gisteren postte staat vanavond bij ons op tafel."

- "Je keuken met dat groene tegelwerk is echt prachtig."

- "Ik zag dat je bijna elke week iets met vis doet - daar zijn er te weinig van."

 

BAD OPENINGS - generic, sounds like a bot

- "Hoi, we vinden je content geweldig!"

- "Je recepten zien er heerlijk uit, zin in een samenwerking?"

 

If a message could have been sent to anyone, it is wrong.

 

This is a quick scan, not deep research. You have about 2 minutes per message. Open the account, glance at the last few posts, grab one real detail, pick the matching Dutch building block, fill it in. Being quick is fine. Skipping the personal detail is not.

 

 

KPIs - HOW YOUR WORK IS MEASURED

 

We measure three things: volume, quality and outcomes. Volume on its own is worth nothing to us. A generic blast does not get paid and it hurts our account.

 

DAILY

- Qualified contacts sent: 150 target, 120 minimum (roughly 130 Instagram DMs + 20
s)

- Pace: about 30 per hour, around 2 minutes each

- Working hours: 5 to 6 hours

- Personal opening line present: 100 percent, always

- Checklist compliance: 100 percent, always

 

WEEKLY

- Qualified contacts sent: 750 target, 600 minimum

- Follow-ups sent on schedule: 100 percent of accounts that are due

- Tracker updated: every day

- One short summary message to me: every Friday

 

MONTHLY

- Qualified contacts sent: 3,000 target, 2,400 minimum (about 22 working days)

- Reply rate: 8 percent target (roughly 240 replies), 6 percent minimum. This is our main quality signal - generic messages destroy it

- Interested creators handed to me: 90 target, 60 minimum

- Duplicate or off-checklist messages: zero. No tolerance, this risks our account

- Spam flags or account restrictions: zero. No tolerance

 

MONTH 1 IS A RAMP MONTH

We expect roughly 60 percent of these numbers in your first month while you learn the niche and the Dutch system. We review together on day 14 and day 30.

 

WEEKLY QUALITY AUDIT

Every week I check 20 random messages from your log. Each one must have a genuinely personal opening line tied to that specific account. Messages that fail the audit do not count toward your paid total.

 

 

PAY

 

This is a performance-based role. There is no fixed monthly salary. You are paid for the work you actually produce and you control your own volume.

 

- $0.10 per qualified Instagram DM

- $0.15 per qualified
 (these take longer and convert better)

- +$50 monthly bonus if you hit 3,000 contacts AND an 8 percent reply rate

- +$50 monthly bonus if you hand over 90 or more interested creators

- $1.00 for every creator who receives a board and actually posts about it

 

WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

- Part-time, around 75 per day: roughly 1,650 a month, about $180 to $230

- Full pace, around 150 per day: roughly 3,300 a month, about $450 to $520

- Strong performer with a high reply rate: $520 and up

 

Paid twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th, via Wise or PayPal, based on your logged and audited contact count.

 

LONGER TERM

If you perform for three months straight, we move you onto a fixed monthly retainer plus bonus, and we grow the role into managing creator relationships from start to finish - onboarding, discount codes, and tracking which creators actually drive sales.

 

 

WHAT WE PROVIDE

 

- Access to the No Layer Kitchen Instagram account

- A VPN set to a Dutch location, which must be on before you ever open the account. This is not optional

- Access to a creator search tool

- The complete Dutch message system: template, opening line library, follow-up sequence

- The Dutch brand PDF to send to interested creators

- The tracker template

- A 60 minute onboarding call, then a short weekly check-in

 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 

- Strong written English. You and I communicate in English every day.

- Careful and detail-oriented. The checklist and the log are the job. I would much rather have 120 real messages than 200 fake ones.

- Genuinely interested in food and cooking. You will be looking at food content for hours. If that sounds enjoyable rather than boring, this is a good fit.

- Self-managing. You set your own hours. Nobody watches your screen.

- Reliable internet and a working laptop or desktop.

 

Instagram outreach or influencer marketing experience is a plus, not a requirement. We train you.

 

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

 

- Anyone planning to copy-paste one message to hundreds of accounts. We audit for it and it does not get paid.

- Anyone who needs a guaranteed fixed salary from day one. This role pays for output.

- Anyone uncomfortable using a VPN or a shared spreadsheet.

 

 

HARD RULES

 

- Never open Instagram without the Dutch VPN on.

- Never contact an account that fails any checklist point.

- Never send the brand PDF in a first cold message. Only after they reply with interest.

- Never make health claims. We sell a better cutting board. We do not cure anything.

- Never promise a specific commission amount in the first message. That is what the brand PDF is for.

- Never contact the same account twice, and never send the exact same wording twice in a row.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with the subject line: NOLAYER - [your first name]

 

Include:

 

1. A short intro. Who you are, and whether you cook.

 

2. THE TEST TASK. Go to Instagram and find TWO Dutch food or cooking accounts that pass all six checklist points. For each one, send me:

   - 
 and their follower count

   - one sentence in English describing the specific detail you would build the opening line around

   - one sentence on why they pass the checklist

 

3. Your realistic daily capacity and the hours you would work.

 

4. Whether you can receive payment through Wise or PayPal.

 

Applications without the test task will not be read. It takes about 15 minutes and it is the only thing I actually score.

 

I reply to every applicant who completes it, within 3 working days.

I’m Max, based in the United States. I’m looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial person who wants to help launch and run a business around something they understand deeply.



Maybe you manage operations, deliver a specialized service, build automations, handle research, or run an important process behind the scenes. You know the tools, the challenges, what customers value, and where there is room for a better offering.



You bring the expertise to deliver. I help with strategy, positioning, sales, and building the business.



I’m open to different industries. What matters is finding an opportunity with:



• Clear demand and customers already spending money on the problem.

• A specific reason customers would choose us.

• Work you have personally done and could confidently lead.

• A practical way to launch with a small team.

• Potential for repeat business and recurring revenue.



This could be a specialized business service, a smarter way to handle an expensive workflow, or a service made faster and better through technology.



You would help shape the offer, build the delivery process, serve our first customers, and eventually lead operations as we grow.



The goal is a long term partnership with meaningful responsibility and shared upside. Compensation, time commitment, and any profit sharing or ownership would be agreed upon before work begins.



To apply, send a short introduction and answer these questions:



1. What business or process do you understand especially well, and what have you personally handled?

2. What would you propose we launch, and who would buy it?

3. What have you seen that tells you customers need this and would pay for it?

4. What would make our offering better, and what would it take to serve our first customer?

5. What could you lead, what support would you need from me, and what availability and compensation would you need initially?



Keep your proposal high level and use general or public examples from your experience. A few thoughtful paragraphs are enough.



If you know the work, see the opportunity, and want a real role in building it, let’s talk.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper – QuickBooks Online
description:
We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Part-Time Bookkeeper to join our team and support the bookkeeping and accounting needs of U.S.-based businesses.



This is not simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping and accounting principles, can accurately determine how transactions should be classified, understands how a Chart of Accounts works, and knows when something does not look correct.



The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for tasks including:



Maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online

Reviewing and categorizing bank and credit card transactions

Understanding and correctly applying the client's Chart of Accounts

Identifying transactions that may be incorrectly classified

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Reviewing accounts for duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly recorded transactions

Accounts payable and accounts receivable support

Understanding and processing payroll

Reviewing payroll reports and payroll-related transactions

Recording payroll entries correctly in QuickBooks

Assisting with month-end bookkeeping and account review

Preparing and reviewing basic financial reports, including:

Profit & Loss

Balance Sheet

General Ledger

Accounts Receivable

Accounts Payable

Maintaining organized financial documentation and supporting records

Communicating questions, discrepancies, or missing information clearly to our team

Following up on unresolved bookkeeping items instead of leaving them incomplete

Required Qualifications



You should have:



Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

A solid understanding of bookkeeping and basic accounting principles

Strong understanding of Charts of Accounts

Experience accurately categorizing and classifying transactions

Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations

Experience with payroll and an understanding of how payroll affects the books

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred

Strong attention to detail

Ability to identify when financial information does not make sense

Ability to research an issue before asking for assistance

Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines

Strong written English communication skills

Ability to communicate questions clearly and provide enough information for someone else to understand the issue

Technology Skills



Our team primarily works within the Microsoft ecosystem. You should be comfortable using:



Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word

Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint

PDF documents and PDF editing/organization tools



Strong Excel skills are important. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, sorting and filtering information, using formulas, and reviewing financial data.



Schedule



This is a 20-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday.



You must be able to work during U.S. Central Time.



We are flexible regarding the exact schedule. An earlier Central Time schedule or a later afternoon Central Time schedule can both work. We care more about establishing a consistent schedule, meeting deadlines, and being available to communicate with our team when necessary.



The schedule can be discussed and finalized with the selected candidate.



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



Candidates with significant U.S. bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, and payroll experience may qualify toward the higher end of the range.



There is an opportunity for increased compensation and transition to a full-time position based on performance, reliability, accuracy, and the growth of the role.



What We Are Looking For



Accuracy is extremely important in this role.



We want someone who does more than simply categorize transactions based on what QuickBooks suggests. You should be able to look at the transaction, understand the business activity, understand the Chart of Accounts, and determine whether the accounting treatment makes sense.



If you are unsure, we expect you to ask. We would rather have a clearly documented question than an incorrect assumption.



At the same time, we value people who are resourceful and will investigate an issue before immediately asking someone else for the answer.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A brief introduction about yourself and your bookkeeping experience.

How many years of QuickBooks Online experience you have.

Whether you have worked with U.S.-based businesses.

Your experience processing or reviewing payroll.

Your experience working with Charts of Accounts.

Your current availability in U.S. Central Time.

Your desired hourly rate.

Any QuickBooks, accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll certifications you currently hold.



Please also answer this question in your application:



A business purchases $650 of materials from Costco. What information would you want to know before d
 which QuickBooks account to categorize the transaction to?



There is not necessarily one correct answer. We are interested in understanding how you think through bookkeeping decisions.

title: Remote Operations & Client Coordinator
description:
Job Title:

Remote Operations & Client Coordinator | Part-Time to Full-Time



Job Description:



NuePrint is a commercial printing, signage, apparel, and branded-products company based in the Chicago area. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Operations & Client Coordinator to help keep customer requests, quotes, orders, production, purchasing, follow-ups, and day-to-day communication moving.



This is not a role where you will simply wait for someone to assign your next task.



We have internal systems, an ERP, documented training materials, and automated workflows. We do not expect you to memorize every product, material, vendor, or process. We do expect you to know how to find answers, verify information, solve routine problems, and take ownership of work without continuous management supervision.



Responsibilities:



- Monitor and follow up on open customer requests.



- Make sure customer questions, approvals, artwork, payments, and other pending items do not get forgotten.



- Prepare and review quotes, orders, and invoices in our ERP.



- Follow up on outstanding quotes, deposits, and invoices.



- If you are unsure about a quote, invoice, or next step, follow up with the person who created it or the account owner before letting it sit.



- Monitor customer deadlines and identify problems before they become urgent.



- Keep Jira project and production statuses accurate.



- Verify actual production status before reporting that a job is current, complete, or ready.



- Source apparel, materials, and outsourced products from approved vendors.



- When an item is unavailable, check other warehouses, backup suppliers, and reasonable alternatives before escalating.



- Review vendor pricing and help keep ERP product and material costs current.



- During slower periods, review stale pricing, open orders, unpaid invoices, customer follow-ups, Jira statuses, purchasing needs, and training materials.



- Maintain accurate customer and order information.



- Research products and vendor information using spreadsheets, vendor websites, internal systems, and company documentation.



- Answer inbound customer and prospect phone calls through our company phone system.



- Make outbound calls to customers, vendors, prospects, and account contacts when follow-up is needed.



- Assist with sales follow-up and, over time, help with outbound prospecting and cold calling.



- Communicate professionally and confidently by phone,
, and internal messaging.



- Communicate clearly with customers, vendors, production staff, sales staff, and management.



What Matters Most:



Printing experience can be learned. What matters most is how you approach the work.



We need someone who consistently:



- Looks for the answer before asking.



- Follows a customer issue through until it is resolved or clearly handed off.



- Verifies information before saying something is complete, accurate, or current.



- Checks alternatives when the first solution does not work.



- Notices and manages deadlines without needing reminders.



- Uses available downtime productively.



Before escalating a routine issue, we expect you to check the available training materials, ERP, previous orders, vendor information, Jira, and other company resources first.



When bringing a problem to management, you should be prepared to explain:



- What is the problem?



- What have you already checked?



- What options did you find?



- What do you recommend?



Requirements:



- Excellent written and spoken English.



- Clear, professional phone communication skills.



- Comfortable answering calls from U.S.-based customers and prospects.



- Comfortable making outbound customer follow-up calls.



- Willing and able to assist with cold calling and sales prospecting as the role develops.



- Strong attention to detail.



- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



- Comfortable researching answers and learning new systems.



- Experience in operations, customer service, order management, purchasing, project coordination, sales support, or a similar role.



- Comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams,
, PDFs, and web-based business software.



- Comfortable working with ERP, CRM, project-management, and vendor-ordering systems.



- Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs, Microsoft applications, ERP systems, and VoIP phone software.



- Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for clear VoIP phone calls and regular online work.



- Reliable headset or microphone setup for professional phone calls.



- Ability to work consistently during agreed hours with overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours.



Experience with ERP systems, Jira, printing, signage, apparel, promotional products, purchasing, cold calling, sales support, or U.S.-based customers is helpful but not required.



Schedule:



- This position begins part-time at approximately 20 hours per week.



- The first 60 days are a training and evaluation period.



- During this time, you will learn NuePrint's systems, procedures, products, vendors, workflow, and communication standards.



- After successfully completing the training period and demonstrating that you can independently handle the responsibilities of the position, the role is expected to transition to full-time at approximately 40 hours per week.



- The full-time transition is based on performance and is not automatic.



Compensation:



- $450-$550 USD per month during the initial 20-hour-per-week training period.



- Starting compensation within the range will depend on experience, written and verbal communication, systems proficiency, customer-service experience, and demonstrated ability to work independently.



- Compensation will increase if the position successfully transitions to full-time after the training period.



How to Apply:



Please include your resume and answer all of the following questions:



- A customer needs an order Tuesday. You
ed them Thursday requesting missing information. It is now Friday morning and they have not responded. What do you do?



- You are ordering apparel and your usual warehouse is out of one size. What do you do before contacting your manager?



- Your manager asks whether all active projects in the project-management system are up to date. How would you verify that before answering?



- You have completed everything assigned to you and still have several hours remaining in your workday. What do you do?



- A potential customer calls asking for pricing, but you do not immediately know the answer. How would you handle the call?



- Are you comfortable making outbound follow-up calls and eventually assisting with cold calling to potential business customers?



Applications that do not answer all six questions will not be considered.
