title: Event Sales & Business Development Assistant
description:
ABOUT SIGNIFICANT AFFAIR

Significant Affair is a wedding and event planning, design, coordination, and event services company serving Central Florida and beyond.



We specialize in weddings, quinceañeras, Sweet 16s, birthdays, corporate events, fairs & festivals, multicultural celebrations, and more.



Our services include event planning and coordination, event design, décor, florals, rentals, custom installations, 360° photo booths, uplighting, dancing on the clouds, projections, catering, bar services, and entertainment.



We are looking for a proactive, organized, motivated, and sales-minded VA who can help generate clients, build venue and business relationships, manage leads, and support daily operations.



This is more than an administrative role. We want someone who actively looks for opportunities, builds connections, follows up, and helps turn opportunities into booked events.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Client Acquisition & Lead Management

- Find potential wedding and event clients actively seeking our services.

- Post services on appropriate platforms and monitor
 groups, wedding communities, portals, and other lead sources.

- Respond to approved inquiries and follow up with leads and past prospects.

- Schedule discovery calls and consultations for Jasmin.

- Maintain the CRM, client portal, and lead tracker.

- Track leads from inquiry through consultation, proposal, booking, or lost lead.

- Send approved packets, questionnaires, and follow-ups.

- Ensure qualified leads are properly tracked and followed up.



2. Venue Relationships

- Research wedding and event venues throughout Central Florida.

- Identify venue managers and appropriate contacts.

- Introduce Significant Affair and schedule meetings for Jasmin.

- Research preferred/approved vendor programs and requirements.

- Identify opportunities to become a preferred vendor.

- Maintain the venue database and track partnership opportunities.



3. Business Development

- Research corporate event opportunities, bridal shows, expos, networking events, and industry opportunities.

- Identify referral and partnership opportunities.

- Research hotels, venues, photographers, caterers, DJs, florists, bridal boutiques, and other event professionals.

- Help develop a preferred vendor and referral network.

- Research new platforms and opportunities for promoting Significant Affair.



4. Client & Event Support

- Send questionnaires, forms, contracts, and approved reminders.

- Organize client folders and documentation.

- Track deposits, payments, deadlines, and unpaid invoices.

- Assist with timelines, vendor contact sheets, setup/teardown checklists, and event-day documents.

- Confirm final details with vendors before events.

- Track RSVPs when applicable.

- Send final documents to vendors and venues 2 weeks before each event.



5. Marketing & Social Media

- Schedule approved social media content.

- Organize and repurpose event photos/videos.

- Create simple Canva graphics using company branding.

- Post approved services and rental inventory.

- Assist with promoting packages and services.

- Research marketing opportunities.

- Request client testimonials and reviews using approved messaging.



6. Support for Jasmin

- Manage consultations, meetings, appointments, and calendar organization.

- Prepare research and information for meetings.

- Follow up after meetings.

- Keep CRM, lead, and business-development records updated.

- Provide a weekly report covering leads, follow-ups, consultations, venue contacts, and business opportunities.



COMPENSATION

Hourly Pay

$6 USD/hour — 20 hours per week (4 days × 5 hours)



Commission

Earn 2% commission on eligible Significant Affair service revenue from new clients you directly generate.



Examples:

$3,000 booking → $60

$5,000 booking → $100

$8,000 booking → $160

$10,000 booking → $200



VA-Generated Lead Requirements

A lead qualifies when the VA:



- Personally identifies the opportunity.

- Initiates / facilitates the initial connection.

- Documents the lead in the lead tracker.

- Helps move the lead to a consultation.

- The client signs a contract and pays Significant Affair.



Commission is paid only after the event is successfully completed and there is no cancellation, refund, or qualifying adjustment.

Commission applies only to eligible Significant Affair service revenue and does not include third-party/vendor costs or rental revenue.



Preferred Vendor Exception

Bookings resulting from Significant Affair being listed, recommended, approved, or designated as a preferred vendor by a venue or organization are not commissionable, even if the VA helped establish the relationship.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 



- Proactive, self-motivated, and dependable

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients and businesses

- Strong online research and professional outreach skills

- Sales-minded without being pushy

- Able to work independently

- Creative, resourceful, and eager to learn



Experience is a plus in:

Virtual assistance, sales, lead generation, business development, customer service, event/wedding planning, hospitality, appointment setting, social media, Canva, or CRM systems.



INITIATIVE IS ESSENTIAL

We don't want someone who waits for instructions for every task.



We want someone who can say:



"I found an opportunity. Here's what I found, here's what I recommend, and here's what I think we should do next." 

"I have an Idea to move the business to the next level"



You'll receive training, direction, and the tools you need, but we expect you to eventually work independently and actively contribute to the growth of Significant Affair. 



We Grow & You Will Grow Too!

title: Video Editor For Dental Videos on YouTube
description:
I have 3 YouTube channels, and I need a new editor who uses DaVinci Resolve. I use a cloud-based team editing approach, which means you will need to learn to edit from proxy files and have the storage space to do it. I do about 3 videos a month. Each video pays $100 for videos under 15 minutes, and I offer up to $150 for longer videos; each video can also earn a bonus. Videos are usually about 7 to 14 minutes long.



REQUIREMENTS

1. YOU MUST USE DAVINCI RESOLVE and have a license to edit from the cloud. (You can use free version for trial but need full version after)

2. After the paid trial, you will need 1.3 TB of AVAILABLE STORAGE SPACE for all the proxies.

3. You must deliver videos on time. 



BONUS: 

I also offer bonuses for videos that don't require much follow-up editing and are done on time. For example, if the video pay is $100 and I don't need many revisions, I offer a $30 bonus, for a total of $130 per video. 



TEAM EDITING PROCESS

My projects are based on team editing, so I can make edits and notes myself. So the process is probably different from what you're used to.



My process involves: 1- Downloading the proxies from my server. 2- Chopping up the A-roll. 3- Adding B-roll. 4- Adding graphics, text, Titles, Transitions, and Music. 5- Changing the revisions that I send.



THE KIND OF VIDEOS & PROJECTS: 

The current channel for this job listing is called Baseline Dental on YouTube; you should watch some of the videos already done on that channel. Once you have my process down and edit well, I have 2 other channels, and I will give you more projects for them to earn more. You can expect to make $350 to $400 per month at first, doing 3 videos a month. If you edit fast and on time, I will move you on to other projects, shorts, and possibly other channels. Then you can expect to make about $400 to $600 or possibly more.



Each video will take about 6 to 8 hours once you are used to the process. It may take longer at first. 



My other channels are called The Proposal and Brielle Buck. However, at first we will just be working with the Baseline Dental channel.



PAID TRIAL:

This paid trial and process will take a few days to learn and set up. But after that, everything will get easier.



I have current editors who have been working for me for 5 years. I have been on YouTube for over 8 years. So this can be a reliable long-term job for you. I hope you will be my next editor!



Please apply and respond if you have used DaVinci and can deliver videos reliably and on time. Talk to you soon!

title: B2B Sales and Account Manager
description:
We have a premium headwear brand based in New York City. We make unbranded, better-fitting caps in three real sizes and sell them direct to consumers and to businesses that want custom embroidered caps for their teams, events, and merch. More than 500 companies have ordered from us, including Google, Shopify, The Ritz-Carlton, and Stanford University.



Our wholesale side is growing fast. We now handle around 125 wholesale and custom orders every month, and we need someone whose full-time job is making sure those customers feel looked after and come back.



## The role



This is a customer relationship role with two halves.



1. Wholesale customer success

- Reach out to every new wholesale customer after their order ships to make sure it arrived and they are happy with it

- Check in with existing accounts on a regular schedule (30, 60, 90 days and beyond) to see how the caps are being used, whether they need a reorder, and whether anything went wrong that we should fix

- Keep our CRM accurate and up to date for every wholesale account, including contact details, order history, notes from each conversation, and next follow-up dates

- Spot reorder opportunities (events coming up, new hires, seasonal needs) and bring them to the team

- Flag any issue, complaint, or at-risk account to the founders right away

- Work closely with the Lift Down team to learn our communication style and upsell tactics, and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and what they need



### 2. Instagram B2B outreach: Many businesses follow our Instagram after seeing one of our B2B ads. They are interested but not ready to order yet, or they mean to come back to our custom cap configurator and forget. Your job is to catch them before they go cold.



- Monitor new followers, likes, comments, saves, and DMs every day and identify which ones are business accounts, brands, agencies, or companies

- Assess whether an account is a legitimate business worth pursuing (real website, real team, real activity) versus a fake, spam, or irrelevant account

- Reach out to qualified accounts by DM or
, introduce Lift Down, and offer a blank sample cap so they can feel the quality

- Point them to our self-serve custom cap configurator and help them get started

- Log every lead in the CRM with a status and a follow-up date, and follow up on schedule until they order or clearly decline

- Report weekly on how many accounts you reached out to, how many replied, how many requested samples, and how many placed an order



## What we are looking for



- At least 2 to 3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or B2B sales, ideally for an ecommerce or product brand

- Sales experience is important. A big part of this role is turning interested followers into customers and existing customers into repeat customers, so you need to be comfortable asking for the order

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to US business owners, marketing managers, and procurement teams every day, and your messages need to read as clear, warm, and professional

- Able to write without relying on AI. Our customers should never feel like they are talking to a bot, so you need to be able to write messages in your own voice and style, without running everything through ChatGPT first. AI tools are welcome for working through complex problems or tightening up a sentence now and then, but your English has to be strong enough to stand on its own

- Hands-on experience keeping a CRM organized (any CRM is fine as long as you are disciplined about it)

- Comfortable doing outreach on Instagram and by
, and comfortable with polite persistence

- Good judgment about people. You can tell the difference between a real company and a time-waster, and you know when to push and when to back off

- Organized and self-directed. You will own your own follow-up calendar and nobody will chase you on it

- A real understanding of how different kinds of businesses work and buy. A 10-person startup, a marketing agency ordering for a client, a hotel, a university, and a Fortune 500 procurement team all have different needs, timelines, and decision makers, and you should be able to adjust how you talk to each one

- Comfortable dealing with large companies. Some of our customers are S&P 500 companies, and you need to be able to hold a professional conversation with them without being intimidated or overly casual

- Familiarity with Shopify is a plus

- Full alignment with the US Eastern schedule. You need to be online and available from at least 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



## Who you are



- Communication is the most important trait for this role. You write clearly, you listen well, and people enjoy hearing from you

- You understand how business relationships actually work. Trust is built over time, not in one message, and a customer who feels remembered is a customer who reorders

- Adaptable and a quick learner. We are a fast-growing company and things change often. You pick up new tools and processes quickly and you are not thrown off when priorities shift

- Comfortable with ambiguity. You will not always have a script, and you are fine figuring things out and asking good questions



## What you get



- A long-term, full-time role with a small team where your work is visible and directly affects the business

- Direct access to the founders. No layers of management

- A clear playbook for the customer journey, plus the freedom to improve it



## How to apply



We would rather read a few strong applications than a hundred generic ones, so please do the following.



(1) Put the words CLASSIC CAP at the start of your application subject line so we know you read this far.



Then, in your application, answer this question in a few sentences. Do not send a template or a copied cover letter.



(1) Tell us about a time you re-engaged a customer or client who had gone quiet. What did you say and what happened?



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

title: ShipBob Logistics & Fulfillment Specialist – E-commerce
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce company looking for an experienced Logistics & Fulfillment Specialist with hands-on ShipBob experience to support and improve our US fulfillment operations.



Previous experience working directly with ShipBob is a key requirement for this role.



We need someone who understands how ShipBob works beyond simply checking order statuses, someone who can confidently navigate the platform, investigate fulfillment and inventory issues, identify operational problems, and work effectively with ShipBob to resolve them.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage and monitor day-to-day fulfillment operations through ShipBob



Investigate unfulfilled orders, fulfillment exceptions, shipping delays, and missing tracking



Monitor inventory across fulfillment centers and identify stock allocation or replenishment issues



Review inventory distribution and help prevent situations where one fulfillment center runs low while another holds excess stock



Manage and investigate kitting/de-kitting and fulfillment exceptions



Monitor ShipBob performance against SLAs and identify recurring issues or trends



Handle and track shipping/fulfillment claims and understand associated fees, reimbursements, and resolutions



Investigate returned-to-sender (RTS), rerouting, delivery exceptions, and returned inventory



Coordinate inventory inbound and transfers when required



Build and maintain fulfillment reports, trackers, and warehouse performance scorecards



Escalate issues to ShipBob with clear supporting data and follow them through to resolution



Work closely with Operations and Customer Experience to reduce fulfillment-related customer issues



What We’re Looking For:



Hands-on professional experience using ShipBob is strongly preferred / required

Experience managing e-commerce fulfillment or 3PL operations

Strong understanding of inventory management, fulfillment SLAs, shipping exceptions, and warehouse operations

Experience investigating issues within ShipBob, not just viewing tracking information

Experience with Shopify and its integration with fulfillment platforms

Understanding of inventory transfers, fulfillment center allocation, kitting, and shipping claims is highly desirable

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent written and verbal English

Able to work independently and proactively identify problems rather than waiting for customer complaints or escalations



How to Apply:

Please answer these questions in your application:



How long have you worked directly with ShipBob, and what was your role?

What tasks did you personally perform inside ShipBob?

Have you managed inventory across multiple ShipBob fulfillment centers? Please explain.

Have you handled WROs/inbounds, inventory transfers, fulfillment exceptions, claims, returns/RTS, or kitting in ShipBob? Which ones?

Describe one significant ShipBob issue you personally investigated and resolved.

What other platforms have you used (e.g. Shopify, ShipStation, other WMS/3PL systems)?



Start your application subject with “SHIPBOB – [number of years/months of direct ShipBob experience]”.



For example: “SHIPBOB – 2 Years”

title: Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager
description:
# Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager



## About Us



We’re an AI-first marketing agency based in Australia, focused on performance, systems, innovation, and building things properly.



We work across paid media, primarily Google Ads and Meta Ads, alongside SEO, automation, AI tools, reporting systems, Shopify, lead generation, and custom internal apps.



We move fast, solve problems quickly, and constantly improve the systems inside the business.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows SOPs.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, identify problems, improve systems, take ownership, and help us scale.



This is not a junior role.



This is a long-term role for somebody who wants to grow with the company and become a core part of the team.



---



## The Role



We are hiring a full-time Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager.



Your role will involve managing campaigns, improving systems, building reporting processes, working with AI tools, solving operational problems, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients.



You will work directly with the founder and become heavily involved in the operational side of the agency.



This is a dynamic role, not a repetitive VA role.



Some weeks you may be:



* launching Meta campaigns

* optimising Google Ads campaigns

* improving reporting systems

* troubleshooting tracking issues

* improving attribution accuracy

* helping build AI workflows

* auditing landing pages

* improving internal systems

* managing Shopify marketing tasks

* identifying inefficiencies before anybody else notices them



We value initiative very highly.



You should already be comfortable independently launching and managing campaigns.



If you wait to be told every small step, this role is not for you.



---



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns

* Setting up and managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Monitoring performance and improving campaign results

* Creating and improving reporting systems

* Building dashboards and client reporting workflows

* Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

* Managing Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and Events Manager setups

* Diagnosing tracking issues and ensuring accurate attribution

* Working with AI tools to improve efficiency

* Assisting with SEO-related tasks and strategy

* Helping improve agency systems and operations

* Identifying problems proactively and solving them independently

* Supporting onboarding workflows for new clients

* Working with Shopify stores where required

* Providing weekly campaign updates and operational updates



Potential future client-facing opportunities are available for candidates with exceptional communication skills and presentation ability.



---



## What We’re Looking For



### Required Skills



* Strong Google Ads experience

* Strong Meta Ads experience

* Good understanding of performance marketing

* Understanding of marketing reporting and analytics

* Comfortable using AI tools daily

* Ability to think independently and solve problems

* Strong written English communication

* Organised and systems-oriented

* High attention to detail



### Highly Valued



* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with GoHighLevel

* Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager

* Strong understanding of GA4

* Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixel and Events Manager

* Experience with attribution and conversion tracking

* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make

* Experience using AI builders/tools such as Lovable

* Basic SEO understanding

* Design eye and understanding of good creative



---



## Growth Opportunity



We are building this role for the long term.



As the company grows, this position will continue to grow and evolve with it.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity for:



* increased responsibility

* leadership opportunities

* involvement in higher-level strategy

* direct collaboration with the founder

* long-term career growth inside the company



This is a remote-first role, however for exceptional long-term tea
mbers, there may also be opportunities over the next 12 to 24 months to become more directly involved with the Australian side of the business if desired.



We are looking for somebody who wants to build something long-term, not somebody looking for a short-term freelance position.



---



## The Type of Person That Will Succeed Here



You:



* take initiative without being asked

* enjoy solving problems

* improve systems naturally

* think critically

* learn quickly

* communicate clearly

* care about results

* want long-term growth

* are comfortable in a fast-moving environment

* use AI to work smarter and faster



You probably will NOT enjoy this role if:



* you need constant supervision

* you wait for instructions for every task

* you avoid ownership

* you struggle with communication

* you prefer repetitive admin-only work



---



## Hours



* Full-time role

* Flexible scheduling where needed

* Must have overlap with Melbourne business hours



---



## To Apply



Please answer the following carefully.



We are not looking for perfect answers. We are looking for your thinking process, problem-solving ability, and how you approach challenges.



### Question 1



Tell us about a marketing or operational problem you noticed before anybody else did.



How did you identify it?

What did you do to solve it?

What was the result?



### Question 2



Imagine a client’s Meta Ads performance suddenly drops by 40% this week.



Walk us through:



* what you would check first

* how you would investigate the issue

* what data you would look at

* what actions you would take



We care far more about your thinking process than having a “perfect” answer.



### Question 3



Tell us about a system or workflow you improved in a previous role.



What was inefficient?

What changes did you make?

What impact did it have?



### Question 4



What AI tools do you currently use in your workflow, and how do they make you more effective?



---



## Final Notes



We are building a high-performance, AI-first agency with strong systems and strong people.



If you are ambitious, proactive, accountable, and want a long-term opportunity where you can grow into a major role inside the company, we’d love to hear from you.

title: CLNR Studios | Colorist
description:
Freelance Colorist — Custom LUT Creation & Color Grading



Company: CLNR Studios  

Engagement : Freelance / project-based  

Location : Remote  

Compensation : Competitive; based on experience and project scope



CLNR Studios is seeking an experienced freelance colorist for ongoing, project-based work. We’re looking for someone with an exceptional eye, strong technical expertise, and the ability to create distinctive visual treatments across commercial, branded, narrative, and social content.



This is a gig-based opportunity for a dependable creative partner we can call on whenever a project requires professional color grading or custom LUT development. We offer a substantial budget for exceptional talent and consistently polished, high-end work.



Responsibilities



- Professionally color-correct and grade footage

- Create technical and creative custom LUTs

- Establish cohesive looks across multiple cameras and lighting environments

- Perform shot matching, skin-tone refinement, and secondary corrections

- Collaborate with directors, editors, and producers to translate references into finished visual treatments

- Prepare grades for web, social, broadcast, and other delivery formats

- Maintain organized project files and reliable color-management workflows

- Complete revisions efficiently and within agreed timelines



Requirements



- Advanced proficiency in DaVinci Resolve

- Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and round-trip workflows

- Proven experience creating custom LUTs

- Thorough understanding of color science, color management, log formats, codecs, scopes, and delivery standards

- Excellent judgment around exposure, contrast, skin tones, color separation, and visual consistency

- Ability to match footage across different cameras and shooting conditions

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to exceptional work

- Dependable communication and deadline management

- Ability to work independently and accommodate fast turnarounds when required



Experience with HDR, ACES, commercials, music videos, fashion, beauty, and remote review platforms is a plus.



To Apply



Please submit:



- A color-grading reel or portfolio

- Before-and-after examples, if available

- Examples of custom LUTs or looks you’ve developed

- A brief description of your workflow and technical setup

- Your availability, typical turnaround time, and project or day rate

- A note clarifying your role in each submitted project



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief paid test using footage supplied by CLNR Studios.



We’re looking to build a long-term relationship with a hardworking, highly skilled colorist—not simply fill a single project. If you combine refined creative taste with technical precision and reliable execution, we’d love to hear from you.
